details.body: Mote, s. biMduH, aRuH, lavaH, aRureRuH, paramARuH, kaRikA; ‘the m(ote) thou seest in the eyes of others, but not the beam in thine own’ KalaH sarzapamAtrARi paricCidrARi paSyati . Atmano bilvamAtrARi paSyannapi na paSyati.
MOTE: binduH: v. Spot, speck.

MOTE , s. aRuH m., aRureRuH m., tramareRuH m. f., rikzA, likzA, kaRaH, kaRikA, pArimARqalyaM, aRureRujAlaM, jAlasUryyamarIcisTaM rajas, jAla- kAntarapravizwAdityaraSmisTitaM yadrajas, DvaMsI m. (n), samAgamaH.
Moth, s. SalaBaH, pataMgaH, kIwaH.
MOTH: GuRaH (?), m.-eaten: GuRakzataH (tA, taM), Si.
MOTH , s. pataNgaH, pataNgamaH, pataNgikA, SalaBaH, SaraBaH, kIwaH; ‘moth like,’ SAlaBaH -BI -BaM.
MOTH-EATEN , a. kIwaBakzitaH -tA -taM, kIwaKAditaH -tA -taM.

Mother, s. mAtf f., jananI, aMbA, janayitrI, prasUH, prasavitrI, janI, prasavinI; ‘m(other) of offspring’ putravatI, sutinI, apatyavatI; ‘m(other)-in-law’ SvaSrUH; ‘m(other) of a hero’ vIrasUH-mAtA, vIraprasavA; ‘born of a different m(other)’ Binnodara, anyodara, asodara. [Mother]hood, a. mAtftvaM, jananItvaM, mAtfBAvaH-DarmaH. [Mother]less, a. amAtfka, hIna-mfta-mAtfka. [Mother]ly, a. mAtfsadfSa (SI f.), mAtf-saMniBa-anurUpa-yogya, mAtf in comp. adv. mAtfvat, mAtfBAvena, mAtfsTAne BUtvA.

MOTHER: I Lit.:(1) mAtA, m. -queen: rAjamAtA; m. -tongue: BAtfBAzA; his father m.ed him: pitEvAsya mAtftAmakarot, C. i.;(2) jananI, I am your m: sA'hamasmi vo jananI, D. v.II Fig., [Page459] parent, source: q. v.:(1) prasavitrI;(2) prasUH; (3) prasUtiH (rare).

MOTHER , s. mAtA f. (tf), jananI, janayitrI, janikA, prajanikA, prajA yinI, prasavinI, prasavitrI, prasavakartrI, prasUH f., sUH f., ambA, ambikA, ambAlikA, janI, prasavasTalI, DAtrI, mA, utpAdikA; ‘mother of a son or of offspring,’ putriRI, putravatI, sutinI, sutavatI, prajA- vatI, apatyavatI; ‘of one child,’ ekodarA; ‘of seven children,’ sutavaskarA; ‘who has recently had a child,’ prasUtikA, sUtikA- prasUtA; ‘step-mother,’ vimAtA f. (tf), sapatnI mAtA; ‘mother- in-law,’ SvaSrUH f.; ‘mother and father,’ mAtApitarO m. du., mAtarapitarO; ‘mother of a hero,’ vIraprasavinI; ‘mother's house,’ mAtfgfhaM; ‘mother's family,’ mAtfkulaM; ‘born of a different mother,’ BinnodaraH -rA -raM, anyodaraH &c., asodaraH &c.
MOTHER , a. (Native) svABAvikaH -kI -kaM, sAhajikaH -kI -kaM, sahajaH -jA -jaM, janma or jAti in comp.; as, ‘mother-tongue,’ janma- BAzA, jAtiBAzA; ‘mother-country,’ janmaBUmiH f.
MOTHER-IN-LAW: SvaSrUH, all (my) m.s: SvaSrUjanaM sarvam, R. xiv. 60.
MOTHER-IN-LAW , s. SvaSrUH f., gurupatnI; ‘mother and father in law, SvaSrUSvaSurO m. du.
MOTHER-OF-PEARL: Suktyudaram (?); *muktAmuKam.
MOTHER-OF-PEARL , s. SuktivaDUH f., SuktipuwaM, muktAsPowaH, muktAgAraM.
MOTHERHOOD: (1) mAtftvam, -tA;(2) jananItvam.
MOTHERHOOD , s. mAtftvaM -tA, jananItvaM, mAtfBAvaH, putriRItvaM, sutinItvaM.
MOTHERLESS: (1) amAtfkaH (kA, kaM), D. ;(2) mAtfhInaH (nA, naM): v. Devoid of.
MOTHERLESS , a. amAtfkaH -kA -kaM, mAtfhInaH -nA -naM, mftamAtfkaH &c., mAtfrahitaH -tA -taM, gatamAtfkaH -kA -kaM, hInamAtfkaH &c.
MOTHERLY: I Pertaining to a mother: (1) by gen. or comp.;(2) mAtfkaH (kA, kaM). II Like a m.:(1) mAtfsannimaH (BA, BaM);(2) expr. with mAtfvat (adv.).
MOTHERLY , a. mAtfsanniBaH -BA -BaM, mAtfsadfSaH -SI -SaM, mAtfkalpaH -lpA -lpaM, mAtftulyaH -lyA -lyaM, mAtfkaH -kA -kaM, mAtf in comp.
MOTHERLY , adv. mAtfvat, mAtfrUpeRa, mAtfBAvena, mAtfDarmmAnusAreRa.
Motile, a. cala, jaMgama.

Motion, s. gati f., gamanaM, calanaM, sarpaRaM, caraRaM. 2 cezwA, vyApAraH, aMgavikzepaH; ‘to set in m(otion)’ Ir c., A-DU 5, 9 U, 6 P, kaMp c. 3 kzoBaH; vegaH, saM-A-vegaH, manovikAraH, manovfttiH-vegaH, BAvaH, vAsana, kalpanA. 4 preraRaM-RA, protsAhanaM, pracodanA. 5 upanyAsaH, upakzepaH, kAryopakzepaH, sUcanA. 6 rekaH, recanaM-nA, uccA-raH. v. i. saMjYAM dA 3 U or kf 8 U, saMketaM dA. [Motion]less, a. niScala, niScezwa, acala, acezwa, gatihIna-SUnya, nizkaMpa, aspaMda, stabDa, sTira.

MOTION (subs.): I Movement: q. v.: gatiH, eastward m.: pUrvagatiH, Gan.; apparent m.: sPuwagatiH, com.; mean (daily) m. of the moon: candrasya (dEnikI) maDyamagatiH Su. com. To be in m.: calati: v. To move.: to set in m.: cAlayati (c. of cal).II Impulse: q. v.: Ph.: of one's own m.: svecCayA.III Feeling: BAvaH.IV Proposal: prastAvaH. (?), to second a m.: prastAvanAm anumodate.
MOTION (v.): iNgitaM karoti: v. To reckon.

MOTION , s. gatiH f., gamanaM, calanaM, cAraH, caraRaM, saYcaraRaM, saraRaM, copanaM kzvelitaM, kzvelikA; ‘swift motion,’ tvaritagatiH f.; ‘slow mo- tion,’ mandagatiH f., mandagamanaM; ‘backward motion,’ viparItagatiH f. — (Animal action) cezwA, cezwitaM. — (Gesture) iNgitaM, iNgaH iNga [Page517-a+ 51] vikzepaH, ANgikacezwA. — (Agitation) kzoBaH, antaHkzoBaH, vegaH. — (Impulse, feeling) vegaH, manovegaH, manovfttiH f., manovikAraH, rAgaH, cittarAgaH, cittakzoBaH, BAvaH, vAsanA, budDiH f., kalpanA, rasaH. — (Pro- position made) karttavyopanyAsaH, upanyAsaH, karttavyasUcakavAkyaM, vAkyaM. — (Stool) rekaH, recanaM -nA, uccAraH, uccaritaM; ‘to put in motion,’ cal (c. 10. cAlayati -yituM).
To MOTION , v. a. iNgitaM kf, saNketaM kf, aNgavikzepaM kf, aNgasaYcAlanaM kf.
MOTIONLESS: niScalaH (lA, laM):: v. Immove- -able.

MOTIONLESS , a. acalaH -lA -laM, niScalaH -lA -laM, niScezwaH -zwA -zwaM, acezwaH &c., nicezwaH &c., gatihInaH -nA -naM, gatiSUnyaH -nyA -nyaM, ni- zkampaH -mpA -mpaM, aspandaH -ndA -ndaM, nizyandaH &c., sTiraH -rA -raM, stabDaH -bDA -bDaM, agatikaH -kA -kaM, sannaH -nnA -nnaM.

Motive, a. cAlaka, preraka, pravartaka, hetuka in comp., kAraRIBUta. s. hetuH, kAraRaM, nimittaM, prayojanaM, kAryaM, arTaH, nidAnaM, nibaMDanaM, pravartakaM, pravftti-nimittaM-hetuH; ‘without m(otive)s’ nizkAraRaM, animittaM, ahetukaM, nizprayojanaM, akasmAt.
MOTIVE (adj.): cAlaka (f. likA) (?): v. To move.

MOTIVE (subs.): rewards are m.s for action: pAritozikalABecCayA narAH karmaRi pravartante; money was the m. for murdering her: arTasya kAraRAdezA mAritA, Mr.; whose m.s cannot be thought of: acintyahetukaH (kA, kaM), Ku. v. 75.: v. Reason, ground, why.
MOTIVE , a. (Causing motion, &c.) cAlakaH -kA -kaM, pravarttakaH -kA -kaM, saYcArakaH -kA -kaM, prayojakaH -kA -kaM, vyApArI -riRI -ri (n), hetukaH -kA -kaM, kAraRikaH -kI -kaM.

MOTIVE , s. (That which incites to action. cause) prayojanaM, hetuH m., kAraRaM, nimittaM -ttakaM, pravfttinimittaM, pravarttakaM, prayojakaM, prayogaH, uttejanaM, uttejakaM, nidAnaM, nibanDanaM, kAryyaM; ‘without motive,’ akasmAt, nipprayojanaM, asati prayojane, akAraRAt, hetunA vinA; ‘relation between the motive and the effect,’ prayojyaprayojakaBAvaH.
Motley, a. citravicitra, nAnAviDa-varRa, bahu-prakAra, viviDa.
MOTLEY (adj.): I Lit.: citravicitra (f. trA). II Fig.: -saNkaraH in comp.
MOTLEY , a. citravicitraH -trA -traM, nAnAviDaH -DA -DaM, nAnAprakAraH -rA -raM, nAnAvarRaH -rRA -rRaM, nAnArUpaH -pA -paM, BinnarUpaH -pA -paM, nAnAraNgI -NgiRI -Ngi (n), bahuraNgI &c., viviDaH &c.
Motor, s. cAlakaH, prerakaH.
MOTOR , MOTORY, a. cAlakaH -kA -kaM, saYcArakaH -kA -kaM, sArakaH &c.
Mottle, v. t. citr 10, karburIkf 8 U. [Mottl]ed, a. citrita, karburita, kalmAzita.
MOTTLED (adj.): karburaH (rA, raM): v. Variega- -ted, spotted.
MOTTLED , a. citritaH -tA -taM, citraH -trA -traM, karbburitaH -tA -taM.
Motto, s. vAkyaM, vacanaM, AdarSavAkyaM.
MOTTO: *AdarSavAkyam.
MOTTO , s. vAkyaM, vacanaM, leKaH, SlokaH, kavitA, vijYApanaleKaH, mudrAleKaH.

Mould, s. saMskAraH, AkAraH, Akfti f., saMsTAnaM, rUpaM; mUtri f. 2 mfd f., mfttikA; mfdu-cUrRaM. 3 prakfti f., kAraRaM. v. t. saMskf 8 U, kxp c., AkAraM-rUpaM-dA 3 U, pravft c., rac 10, rUp 10. [Mould]y, a. malina, malAvfta, samala, kalaMkamaya (yI f.).
MOULD: (subs.): I For casting: perh. saYcaH (comp. Bengali sAMca); saMyAnaH, Wilson.II Form, shape: q. v.: BUrtiH.III A concre- -tion: piRqa (mn (?).
MOULD (v.): I To shape: q. v.: rUpayati (rUp, c. 10.).II To knead: q. v.

MOULD , s. (Earth, soil) mfttikA, mfd f., mfdA, pAMSuH m., BUmiH f., KalaM; ‘black mould,’ nIlamfttikA. — (Concretion formed from damp) kalaNkaH, SuklakalaNkaH, kledajakalaNkaH, kledajamalaM. — (Cast) saMskAraH, A- kAraH, AkftiH f., mUrttiH f., saMsTAnaM, saMyAnaH, rUpaM.

To MOULD , v. a. (Cause to contract mould) sakalaNkaM -NkAM kf, kalaNkena duz (c. 10. dUzayati -yituM), kalaNka (nom. kalaNkayati -yituM), kledajamalena duz. — (Fashion, form) saMskf, kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM), rUp (c. 10. rUpayati -yituM), sarUpaM -pAM kf, rac (c. 10. racayati -yituM), saMskAraM kf.
To MOULD , v. n. (Contract mould) sakalaNkaH -NkA -NkaM BU, kledavyAptatvAt SuklakalaNkaM or SuklamalaM banD (c. 9. baDnAti, bandvuM), kalaNkAvftaH -tA -taM, BU.
MOULDED , p. p. kalpitaH -tA -taM, saMskftaH -tA -taM. — (Kneaded) marditaH &c.
Moulder, v. i. viSF pass., jF 4 P, cUrRiBU 1 P, avasad 1 P, SanEH naS 4 P or kzi pass.
MOULDER (v.): (1) viSIryate (pass. of Sf): v. To decay.
To MOULDER , v. n. cUrRIBU, kzi in pass. (kzIyate), viSF in pass. (-SIryyate); viSIrRIBU, jF (c. 4. jIryyati), SanEH SanEH kzi or naS (c. 4. naSyati), alpAlpaSaH kzIRIBU or nyUnIBU.
MOULDERING , part. SanEH SanEH kzIyamARaH -RA -RaM, alpAlpaM viSIryyamARaH &c.
MOULDINESS: Of soil: mfdumfnmayatA (?).
MOULDINESS , MOLDINESS, s. sakalaNkatA, samalatA, malinatA, kalaNkavattvaM.
MOULDING , MOLDING, s. saMskAraH. — (Projecture of a wall) Bitti- SIrzaM -rzakaM.
MOULDY: Of soil: mfdumfnmayaH (yI, yaM) (?).
MOULDY , a. sakalaNkaH -NkA -NkaM, samalaH -lA -laM, malinaH -nA -naM, kalaNkA- vftaH -tA taM, kalaNkamayaH -yI -yaM, kalaNkavAn -vatI -vat (t), malAvftaH &c., SuklakalaNkAvftaH &c.
Moult, v. i. pakzAn pat c. or muc 6 P or c. [Moult]ed, a. mukta or patita-pakza or parRa. [Moult]ing, s. pakza or parRa-patanaM or galanaM.
MOULT: paSupakziRAM romAdIni pAtayati (c. of pat).

To MOULT , MOLT, v. n. (Shed the feathers) pakzAn or vArzikapakzAn pat (c. 10. pAtayati -yituM) or muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM, c. 10. moca- yati -yituM) or nirmuc, vArzikapakzapAtaM kf, pakzanirmokaM kf, pakzagalanaM kf, pakzaparivarttanaM kf.
MOULTED , p. p. galitapakzaH -kzA -kzaM, muktapakzaH &c., patitaparRaH -rRA -rRaM.
MOULTING , s. pakzapAtaH, pakzapatanaM, vArzikapakzapatanaM, pakzanirmokaH, pakzagalanaM, vArzikapakzagalanaM, vArzikapakzaparivarttanaM.
Mound, s. vapraH-praM, cayaH, setuH, Ali f., piM-qalaH. 2 mfdrASiH, mfttikAcayaH, kzudraparvataH, vAmalUraH, nAkuH, valmIkaH-kaM.
MOUND: vapra (mn.): v. Also hill.

MOUND , s. (Bank, rampart) vapraH -praM, cayaH, setuH m., piRqanaH, piRqalaH, prAkAraH, DUlikuwwimaM, DUlikedAraH. (Elevation, hillock, heap of earth) mfttikAcayaH, unnataBUBAgaH kzudraparvataH, nAkuH m., vAmalUraH.

Mount, v. t. A-aDi-ruh 1 P, aDikram 1 U, 4 P. 2 Aruh c. (ropayati), urDvaM gam c. (gamayati), uccIkf 8 U, niviS c. 3 Kac 10 (Kacayati); See Inlay. v. i. (aSvaM, raTaM, &c.) A-aDi-ruh, aDikram, aDyAs 2 A. 2 urDvaM gam 1 P or cal 1 P. [Mount]ed, a. ArUQa, Aropita; ‘a m(ounted) soldier’ hayArUQaH sEnikaH, sAdin m. [Mount]ing, s. ArohaH-haRaM, AropaRaM.

Mount, Mountain, s. parvataH, adriH, giriH, SElaH, nagaH, acalaH, mahIDraH, ahAryaH, DaraH, gotraH, grAvan, SiloccayaH, sAnumat, SiKa-rin; and comp. of Bft or Dara with ‘Earth’, q. v.; kzmABft, mahIDaraH, kzitiDaraH &c.; ‘western m(ountain)’ astaH, astAcalaH, caramakzmABft; ‘eastern m(ountain)’ udayaH, udaya-giriH-parvataH; ‘hill near a m(ountain)’ pAdaH, pratyaMta-parvataH; ‘te make m(ountain)s out of trifles’ aRumapi parvatIkf 8 U, tile tAlaM dfS 1 P. a. parvatIya, SEla (lI f.), (s.) in comp. [Mountain]eer, s. parvata &c. -nivAsin m., SElAwaH. [Mountain]ous, a. SElamaya (yI f.), nagaprAya, saparvata, parvatIya. 2 (Huge) parvatapramARa.
MOUNT (subs.): SElaH: v. Mountain.

MOUNT (v.t.): I Lit.: to get up: A-rohati, aDi-, (rUh, c. 1.).II To furnish with horses: A-rohayati, aDi-, (c. of ruh).III To set: nidaDAti (DA, c. 3.).IV To raise: uccEH karoti. Ph.: to m. guard: rakzAsTAnamaDitizWati (?).
MOUNT (v. i.): I To ascend: q.v.II On horse-back: aSvam Arohati.

To MOUNT , v. n. (Rise on high) UrdDaM gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM), upari gam, uccEr gam, UrdDvagamanaM kf, uparigamanaM kf. — (Mount on horseback) aSvam Aruh (c. 1. -rohati -roQuM) or aDiruh or aDyAruh or samA- ruh or aBiruh or aDikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), aSvArohaRaM kf; ‘to mount along side,’ anvAruh, samanvAruh.

To MOUNT , v. a. (Raise on high) UrdDvIkf, uccIkf, UrdDvaM gam (c. 10. gamayati -yituM), uccEH kf. — (Climb, ascend, as a hill or a horse) Aruh (c. 1. -rohati -roQuM), aDiruh, aDyAruh, samAruh, aBiruh, aDikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), avaskand (c. 1. -skandati -skantuM), A- rohaRaM kf. — (Place upon) Aruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM), samAruh.

MOUNTAIN: (1) parvataH, a range of m.s: kulaparvataH, V. p.;(2) giriH, waters of m.-streams: girinadIsalilAni, Sa.;(3) SElam, m.-residence: SElavAsaH, Ki.;(4) adriH, the summit of a m.: adreH SfNgam;(5) nagaH, chief of m.s: nagADirAjaH, Ku.;(6) BUDaraH and sim. comp.s.;(7) acalaH; (8) SiKarin (m.).

MOUNTAIN , s. parvataH, giriH m., SElaH, adriH m., mahIDaraH, BUDaraH, vayu- DADaraH, DaraRIDaraH, DarADaraH, mahIDraH, jagatIDaraH, BUBft m., BUGraH, kzmA- Bft m., kzitiDaraH, urvvIDaraH, kuDraH DaraH, DaraRIkIlakaH, SiKarI m. (n), pfTuSeKaraH, tuNgaSeKaraH, sAnumAn m. (t), kakudmAn m. (t). kaku- dmI m. (n), nagaH, SiloccayaH, gotraH, ahAryyaH, grAvA m. (n), valAhakaH, pfTunitambaH; ‘crest or peak of a mountain,’ SiKaraM, giriSiKaraM, parvataSfNgaM, parvatAgraM, parvatamastakaH, kakud f.; ‘brow of a mountain,’ girimUrdDA m. (-dda); ‘side or ridge,’ kawakaH, nitambaH; ‘mountain with three peaks,’ trikUwaH, trikakud m.; ‘Western mountain, behind which the sun sets,’ astaH, caramAcalaH, caramAdriH m., caramakzmABft m., paScimaparvataH; ‘Eastern mountain, over which the sun rises,’ udayaH, udayaparvataH, udayagiriH m., udayaSElaH, udayAcalaH, udayAdriH m., pUrvvaparvvataH; ‘hill near a moun- tain,’ pAdaH, pratyantaparvataH; ‘land at the foot of a mountain,’ upatyakA; ‘on the top,’ aDityakA; ‘range of mountains,’ kulaparvataH, kulAcalaH, kulagiriH m., kulaSElaH. There are seven principal ranges of mountains given, viz. mahendraH, malayaH sahyaH, SuktimAn, fkzaH, vinDyaH, pAripAtraH -trakaH or pAriyAtraH -trakaH. Other names of celebrated mountains or mountain ranges are himavAn, himAlayaH, himAdriH m., hemakUwaH, AmrakUwaH, mAlyavAn m. (t), nizaDaH, mEnAkaH also called hiraRyanABaH and himavatsutaH, ganDa- mAdanaH, citrakUwaH, krOYcaH or kroYcaH.

MOUNTAIN , a. pArvataH -tI -taM, parvatIyaH -yA -yaM, pArvatIyaH -yA -yaM, gEraH -rI -raM, gErikaH -kI -kaM, gEreyaH -yI -yaM, SElaH -lI -laM, pArvateyaH -yI -yaM, parvata or giri in comp.; as, ‘mountain torrent,’ girinadI.
MOUNTAIN-DEW: i. e. Scotch whisky: *giri- madirA.
MOUNTAINEER: (1) (pa) pArvatIyaH (yA, yaM), Ku.;(2) parvatavAsin (f. nI) and sim. comp.s.
MOUNTAINEER , s. parvatavAsI m. (n), girivAsI m., parvatIyajanaH, pArva- tIyaH, girijaH, SElajanaH, giriBUH m., SElAwaH.
MOUNTAINOUS: I Lit.:(1) pa(pA)rvatIyaH (yA, yaM); (2) SElamayaH (yI, yaM); and sim. comp.s.II Huge: parvatapramARa (f. RA) and sim. comp.s.
MOUNTAINOUS , a. pArvatIyaH -yA -yaM, pArvateyaH -yI -yaM, parvatIyaH -yA -yaM, saparvataH -tA -taM, parvatamayaH -yI -yaM, saSElaH -lA -laM, samahIDaraH -rA -raM.
Mountebank, s. miTyA-Cadma-vEdyaH, kUwa-cikitsakaH.
MOUNTEBANK: pIWamardaH (?): v. Quack.
MOUNTEBANK , s. CadmavEdyaH, miTyAvEdyaH, kitavaH, DUrttaH, kApawikaH.
MOUNTED , p. p. ArUQaH -QA -QaM, ArIpitaH -tA -taM, ropitaH -tA -taM, samAropitaH -tA -taM, samArUQaH &c., aDirUQaH &c., rUQaH &c.; ‘on horseback,’ aSvArUQaH, aSvArohI m. (n), hayArUQaH, turagArUQaH.
MOUNTING (subs.): I Ascent: q. v.II On horse-back: aSvArohaRam.III Equipment, embellishment: q. v.

MOUNTING , s. (Rising) UrdDvagamanaM, uparigamanaM. — (Ascending, getting on horseback) ArohaH -haRaM, aDirohaRaM, samArohaH -haRaM. — [Page518-a+ 51] (Placing on horseback) AropaRaM, samAropaRaM, ArUQIkaraRaM.

Mourn, v. anu-, Suc 1 P, vilap 1 P, pari-dev 1 A, paridiv 10 A, rud 2 P, AkraMd 1 P, AkruS 1 P; See Lament. [Mourn]er, s. paridevakaH, vilApin m., SocakaH, vilapana-kft. [Mourn]ful, a. SokArTaka, Soka-duHKa-garBa, duH-KAvedin. 2 SokAvaha, Sokaprada, duHKada, duH-KAvaha, Socya, SokArha. 3 (Of persons) SokArta, SokAkula, saSoka, Kinna, duHKita, Kedayukta-anvita, udvignamanas, vimanas, vizaRRa, samanyu. [Mourn]fully, adv. saSokaM, saKedaM, saduHKaM, sodvegaM. [Mourn]fulness, s. SokaH, duHKaM, udvegaH. [Mourn]ing, s. SokaH, KedaH, vilApaH, paridevanaM, duHKaM, udvegaH, A-, kraMdanaM, rodanaM; See Grief. 2 aSOcaM; ‘one should be in m(ourning) for 10 days’ daSadinamaSOcaM DA-rayet; ‘m(ourning)-dress’ amaMgalavezaH, Sokadyo-tako vezaH.
MOURN (v.): (1) Socati, anu-, pari-, (Suc, c. 1.); (2) vilapati (lap, c. l.);(3) pari-devayate (div, c. 10 (rare).

To MOURN , v. n. Suc (c. 1. Socati -cituM), anuSuc, pariSuc, SokaM kf, SokArttaH -rttA -rttaM BU. SocanaM kf, Kid (c. 4. Kidyate, KettuM), pariKid, duHKa (nom. duHKAyate, duHKIyate), vilap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM), pralap, lap, udvij (c. 6. -vijate -jituM), vyaT (c. 1. vyaTate -TituM), pravyaT, sampravyaT, tap in pass. (tazyate), paritap, santap, rud (c. 2. roditi tuM), paridev (c. 1. -devate -vituM), du (c. 4. dUpate); ‘mourn ex- ceedingly,’ Suc in freq. (SoSucyate).

To MOURN , v. a. (Grieve for) anuSuc (c. 1. -Socati -cituM), paridev (c. 1. -devati -te -vituM), vilap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM), krand (c. 1. krandati -ndituM), Akranda, rud (c. 2. roditi -tuM), aBikruS (c. 1. -kroSati -krozwuM).
MOURNED , p. p. SocitaH -tA -taM, anuSocitaH &c., vilapitaH -tA -taM.
MOURNER: SocakaH, anu-; better by adj.

MOURNER , s. SocakaH, anuSocakaH, SokI m. (n), KedI m. (n), pari- devI m. (n), paridevakaH, vilapanakfta m., vilApI m., SokakarttA m. (rttf), anutApI m., KidyamAnaH. — (One who wears a funeral dress) amaNgalavezI m. (n).
MOURNFUL: I Expressing sorrow: SokasUcaka (f. cikA) and sim. comp.s.II Full of sorrow: SokAkulaH (lA, laM) and sim. comp.s. [Page460] III Causing sorrow: SokakaraH (rI, raM) and sim. comp.s.

MOURNFUL , a. (Expressing sorrow) SokasfcakaH -kA -kaM, KedasUcakaH &c., SokavoDakaH -kA -kaM, SokArTakaH -kA -kaM. — (Sorrowful, said of persons) SokA -kinI -ki (n), SokArttaH -rttA -rttaM, SokAnvitaH -tA -taM, saSokaH -kA -kaM, KedI &c., KedayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, KinnaH -nnA -nnaM, udvignaH -gnA -gnaM, udvignasanAH -nAH -naH (m), vizAdI &c., duHKI &c., duHKAnvitaH -tA -taM, durmanAH &c., vimanAH &c., samanyuH -nyuH -nyu. — (Causing sorrow, lamentable) SokajanakaH &c., SokadaH -dA -daM, SocanIyaH -yA -yaM, SocyaH -cyA -cyaM, SocitavyaH -vyA -vyaM, SokAvahaH -hA -haM, duHKAvahaH &c., KedajanakaH -kA -kaM, SokArhaH -rhA -rhaM, SocanArhaH &c.,
MOURNFULLY: (1) saSokam;(2) better by adj.
MOURNFULLY , adv. saSokaM, saKedaM, saduHKaM, sodvegaM, Sokena, SokapUrvvaM.
MOURNFULNESS: I Sorrow, grief: SokAkulatA and sim. comp.s.II Sadness, as of places: SocyatA.III Expression of sorrow: Soka- sUcakatA and sim. terms.
MOURNFULNESS , s. SokaH, maSokatA, duHKaM, duHKitA, udvegaH, udvignatA, KedaH, SocyatA, SocanIyatA, SAkajanakatA.
MOURNING (subs.): I As felt: SokaH: v. Grief, sorrow.II As expressed by dress, etc.: to be in m.s: SucA or Sokena tizWati (?); dressed in m. *SokavAsAMsi pariDAya, etc.

MOURNING , s. (Sorrow, lamentation) SokaH, SAcanaM, anuSocanaM KedaH, vilapanaM, vilApaH, paridevanaM -nA, rodanaM, rudanaM, krandanaM, AkrandanaM, duHKaM. — (Dress worn by mourners) amaNgalavezaH, aSuBavezaH, amaNgalakAlInavezaH, aSuBakAlInavezaH, SokamUcakavezaH. According to the Hindu notion defilement is contracted by the death of a relation; hence the following terms, expressive of a season of mourning, imply a season of impurity as, aSOcaM, ASOcaM, kAlASOcaM, aGAhaH; ‘one in such a state,’ ASOcI -cinI -ci (n).
Mouse, s. mUza(zi)kaH, AKuH, uMdaruH, bile-SayaH, KanakaH; ‘small kind of mice’ girikA, bAlamUzikA.
MOUSE: BUzi(za)kaH, its hole: bilam or vivaram, H.; by the smell of a m.: mUzikaganDena, Mah.; m.- trap *mUzikabanDaH or mUzikagrahayantram.
MOUSE , s. mfzikaH -kA, mUzakaH, AKuH m., induraH, induruH m., giriH f., girikA, dInA, vileSayaH, vajradantaH, DAnyAriH m., cikkA.
MOUSE-TRAP (v.): *mUpikabanDena baDnAti (banD, c. 9).
MOUSE-TRAP , s. mUpikagrahaRArTaM kUwapantraM, mUpikonmATaH, mUpikapaYjaraH.
MOUSER: *mUzikagrahaH or -grAhakaH and sim. comp.s.
MOUSTACHE: gumPaH.

Mouth, s. muKaM (in all senses); darImuKaM, GawamuKaM, nadImuKaM, &c.; vaktraM, vadanaM, AnanaM, AsyaM; tuMqaM, lapanaM (of animate beings only); ‘corner of the m(outh)’ sfkkan n., sfkkaM, ozWaprAMtaH; ‘rinsing the m(outh)’ AcamanaM; ‘stop the m(outh)’ vAcaM staMB 9 P or c. 2 CidraM, raMDraM, dvAraM, muKaM; ‘m(outh)-piece’ muKanAlI; muKaM (fig.). v. sagarvaM-udDataM-vad 1 P. 2 carv 1 P, 10; gras 1 A, Bakz 10. [Mouth]ful, s. grAsaH, kavalaH, piMqaH, gaMqUzaH (of water). [Mouth]less, a. muKahIna, nirAnana.

MOUTH (subs.): I Lit.:(1) muKam, from the m. of Vasantaka: vasantakasya muKAt, K.s.; of unchecked m.: ayantritamuKaH (KA, KaM), D. viii.; honey in m., (but) poison in heart: muKamaDurhf daya- vizaH, Sa. v.;(2) vaktram;(3) Asyam;(4) Ananam;(5) vadanam. N.B. These words also mean face and when the meaning is doubtful, ranGra should be added, as vaktraranDram, R. ix. 63.II Of things:(1) muKam, pots with closed m.s.: apinadDamuKA GawAH, Ve. iii.; rising from the m.s of caves: darImuKotTaH, Ku. i. 8.;(2) vaktram, the m. of a quiver: nizaNgavaktram, Ki. xvii. 36.; hundred-m.ed hole: SatamuKaM bilam, Mah.: v. Also orifice.III Of a river: muKam, waters at the m. of a river: nadI- muKAmBaH, R. xiii. 10.IV Fig.: muKam, grammar, the m. of all learning: sarvavidyAnAM muKaM vyAkaraRam, K. s. vi. 144.
MOUTH (v.): I To devour: q. v.: grasate (gras, c. l.).II To speak out, rant q. v.: SabdAyate (nomi.).

MOUTH , s. muKaM, vadanaM, AsyaM, vaktraM, AnanaM, lapanaM, tuRqaM -RqaH, tuRqiH -RqI m. f., Sman indec.; ‘the corner of the mouth,’ sfkkan n., mfkkaM, sfkvan n., mfkvaM, sfkki n., mfkvi n., sfkkin n., sfkvin, sfkkiRI f., mfkviRI; ‘the two corners,’ sfkkaRI n. du., ozWaprAntO m. du.; ‘dryness of the mouth, muKaSozaH; ‘washing the mouth,’ muKamArjanaM, muKaprakzAlanaM ‘rincing the mouth,’ AcamanaM; ‘to open the mouth,’ muKaM vyAdA; ‘to stop the mouth,’ vAkmnamBaM kf; ‘from the mouth,’ muKatas; ‘relating to the mouth,’ muKatIyaH -yA -yaM. — (Aperture, orifice) muKaM, CidaM, dvAraM, pramuKaM. — (Mouth of a river) samBedaH, saNgamaH, sinDusaNgamaH.

To MOUTH , v. a. and n. (Speak with a big pompous voice) [Page518-b+ 51] uccEHsvareRa or garvitasvaraRa vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), udDatasvareRa vad. — (Chew, devour) carv (c. 1. carvati -rvituM, (c. 10. carvayati -yituM), gram (c. 1. grasati -situM), Bakz (c. 10. Bakzayati -yituM).
MOUTHFUL: (1) grAsaH, large m.: mahAn grAsaH, Mah.;(2) kavalaH (rare), a few m.s of fresh Dub: katipayadUrvAprabAlakavala-, K. ;(3) muzwiH (= handful).
MOUTHFUL , s. grAsaH, piRqaH, muKapUraRaM, kavalaH, kavakaH, gaRqUzaH -zA, gaqolaH, gaRqolaH, guqeraH -rakaH, sinaH; ‘three mouthfuls of water,’ jalagaRqUzatrayaM.
MOUTHLESS , a. muKahInaH -nA -naM, muKarahitaH -tA -taM, nirmuKaH -KA -KaM.
MOUTHPIECE: I Of a wind instrument: muKam.II A spokesman: muKam, therefore you become my m.: tattvaM me muKaM mava, V. i.
MOUTHPIECE , s. muKanAlI, puwaH, jihvAlI; ‘of a flute,’ dardurapuwaH. — (One who speaks for others) muKaM.

MOVABLE , a. caraH -rA -raM, carizRuH -zRuH -zRu, calaH -lA -laM, calanaH -nA -naM, calizRuH &c., jaNgamaH -mA -maM, gaptanaSIlaH -lA -laM, gamanayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, gamanaSakyaH -kyA -kyaM, asTAvaraH -rA -raM, trasaH -sA -saM, jagan -gatI -gat (t), iNgaH -NgA -NgaM, calanakzamaH -mA -maM; ‘movable and immovable,’ carAcaraH -rA -raM, calAcalaH -lA -laM.
MOVABLENESS , s. carizRutA, calizRutA, gamanaSIlatA, calanayogyatA, gatiSIlatvaM, asTAvaratA, caraBAvaH, calaBAvaH, gamanaSaktiH f.
MOVABLES , s. pl. asTAvarARi n. pl., asTAvaradravyaM -vyARi n. pl., caradra- vyARi, caladravyARi, jaNganadravyARi, asTAvaraDanaM.

(Bramayati); sTAnAMtaraM gam c. (gamayati). 2 kfz 1 P, prer c., pravft c.; protsah c., nud 6 P or c., pracud 10, cezw c., ud-pra-yuj 10. 3 dayAM-karuRAM-utpad c., hfdayaM spfS 6 P or ArdrIkf 8 U, dru c., upahan 2 P; AkzuB c. 4 upanyas 4 U, upa-kzip 6 P, upasTA c. (sTApayati); ‘to be m(ov)ed’ ArdrIBU 1 P, (karuRayA) dru 1 P or dravIBU; See Melt, Affect; ‘he appears to be m(ov)ed’ dravIBUta iva lakzyaMte; ‘let my presence m(ove) (you)’ mAmavalokyApi tAvatkaruRArdrA Bavata; ‘she was m(ov)ed to tears’ taTA dravIBUtA yaTA aSrURi vyamuMcat; ‘he was deeply m(ov)ed by what I said’ mama vacasA tasya cetasi dfQaM padaM cakre; ‘m(ov)ed with grief’ Sokopahata, duHKABiBUta, Sokaspfzwa; ‘m(ove) a chess-man’ SAriM pari-RI 1 P. s. gamanaM, calanaM, saraRaM &c.; ‘m(ove) at chess’ pari(rI)RAyaH. [Mov]able, a. cala, cara, jaMgama, carizRu, calana-gamana-SIla-kzama, asTAvaraH ‘m(ovable) and im-m(ovable) world’ carAcaraM viSvaM, aKilaM jagat. [Mov]ables, s. caradravyARi, asTAvaradravyajAtaM. [Mov]ed, a. calita, prerita, &c.; ‘gently m(oved)’ vellita, preMKita, ADUta, calita, AkaMpita, Duta. [Mov]er, s. cAlakaH, calanaH. 2 upakzepakaH, upanyAsa-kft m. 3 pravartakaH, prayojakaH, prerakaH. [Mov]ing, a. cara, cala, jaMgama. 2 calat; gAmin, yAyin, visarpin, in comp. 3 hfdayaspfS, hfdayagrAhin, marmaspfS-Bid, hfdayaMgama, dayA-vaha, karuRAtmaka, hfdayadrAvin. [Mov]ingly, adv. hfdayagrAhitayA, hfdayaMgamaM. [Move]ment, s. calanaM, saraRaM, yAnaM, gati f., sTAnAMtaragamanaM. 2 vyApAraH, cezwA, kriyA, kfti f., cezwitaM, pravftti f.; ‘graceful m(ovement)’ vilAsaH, vi-BramaH; See under Graceful. 3 cAlanaM, BramaRaM; ‘circular m(ovement)’ maMqalaBramaRaM. 4 kzoBaH, kaMpaH. 5 grAmaH, mUrCanA.
MOVE (subs.): I Movement: q.v.: calanam. II In play:(1) cAlanam (?: comp. Bengali cAla);(2) pariRAyaH, A.III. An ingenious course of proceeding: perh. kOSalam.

MOVE (v. i.): I In gen.:(1) calati (cal, c. l.), m.ing dust: caradDarADUli-, Ku.; the girl m.d: cacAla bAlA, Ku. v. 84.; for the minds of (persons) seeking victory do not m. from policy: calati nayAnna jigIzatAM hi cetaH, Ki. x. 29.; (2) gacCati (= to go) q.v.: v. Also to remove.II To make a motion: *prastAvaM or prastAvanAM karoti.

MOVE (v. t.): I Lit.: cAlayati, vi-, saM-, aBi-, (c. of cal), shalt not m. that: tAM na vicAlayet, Vri. Ph.: to m. the bowel: virecayati (c. of ric), Sr.II To affect, as with gold: cAlayati, vi-; gen. expr. with calati.III To excite: q. v.: janayati (c. of jan). Ph.: m.d to pity: ArdrIkftahfdayaH (yA, yaM), K.

To MOVE , v. a. (Put in motion, cause to change place) cal (c. 10. cAlayAta -yituM), vical, saYcal, sf (c. 10. sArayati -yituM), car (c. 10. cArayati -yituM), saYcar, sTAnAntaraM gam (c. 10. gamayati -yituM), sTAnAntarIkf. — (Impel) prer (c. 10. -Irayati -yituM), nud (c. 6. nudati, nIttuM), praRud, cud (c. 10. codayati -yituM), pracud, saYcud. — (Draw) kfz (c. 1. karpati, c. 6. kfpati -te, krazwuM), sAmAkfz. — (Incite to action, influence) pravft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM), prayuj (c. 10. -yojayati -yituM), protsah (c. 10. -sAhayati -yituM), utsah cezw (c. 10. cezwayati -yituM), praruc (c. 10. -rocayati -yituM), prer. — (Excite ten- derness, pity, &c.) karuRAM jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM), kAruRyaM or dayAm utpada (c. 10. -pAdayati -yituM), hfdayaM vyaD (c. 4. viDyati, vyadDuM), hfdayaM spfS (c. 6. spfSati, sprazwuM), hfdayam ArdrIkf. — (Affect) upahan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM); ‘with grief,’ SokopahataM -tAM kf. — (Agitate) kzuB (c. 10. kzoBayati -yituM), vikzuB, vyAkzuB. — (Make a proposal) upanyas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), karttavyopanyAsaM kf, kartta- vyopasTApanaM kf, karttavyodnAvanaM kf. — (Move away, move off) apamf, apAnud, apanud, vyapanud. — (Move a piece at chess) SAriM pariRI (c. 1. -Rayati -RetuM) or samantAd nI, SAripariRAyaM kf.

To MOVE , v. n. cal (c. 1. calati -lituM), sf (c. 1. marati sarttuM), pramf, car (c. 1. carati -rituM), gama (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM), yA (c. 2. yAti -tuM), i (c. 2. eti -tuM), iNga (c. 1. iNgati -NgituM), cup (c. 1. copati pituM), aMh (c. 1. aMhate -hituM), gativiSizwaH -zwA -zwaM BU. — (Change place) sTAnAntaraM gama, sTalAntaraM gam or yA. — (Change residence) gfhAntaraM gam, vAsAntaraM gam. — (Have vital action) cezwa (c. 1. cezwate -zwituM), AtmAnaM cezw, cezwAM kf. — (Begin in a march) prasTAnaM kf, prasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM); ‘move on,’ prasf, pragam, prayA, cal; ‘move off,’ apasf, apayA, apakram (c. 1. -krAmati, kramituM), apagam; ‘move about,’ itastataH sf or cal, parimf.
MOVE , s. calanaM, saraRaM, gamanaM, cezwA, iNgitaM, mTAnAntaraM, sTAnAntaragamana — (At chess, &c.) pariRAyaH, parIRAyaH, SArinayanaM, KelA -lanaM.
To MOVE , v. a. l. 6. for sAmAkfz, read samAkfz.

MOVEABLE: (1) calaH (lA, laM), love for friends is surely not m.: na Kalu prema calaM suhfjjane, Ku. iv. 28.;(2) caraH (rA, raM) (lit.), hence is m. and im.-m. world: ataScarAcaraM viSvam, Ku. ii. 5.; (3) jaNgamaH (mA, maM) (lit.), m. and im.-m. being: jaNgamaH sTAvaraSca BUtagrAmaH, U. vii. M.s., im.-m.s, gold: jaNgamaM sTAvaraM hema, Vri.

MOVED , p. p. cAlitaH -tA -taM, calitaH -tA -taM, cAritaH -tA -taM, saYcAritaH -tA -taM, sAritaH -tA -taM, pracalitaH -tA -taM, sTAnAntaragataH -tA -taM, sTAnAntaraprAptaH -ptA -ptaM, sTalAntarApannaH -nnA -nnaM. — (Impelled) preritaH [Page519-a+ 51] -tA -taM, praRoditaH -tA -taM, praRunnaH -nnA -nnaM, pracoditaH -tA -taM. — (Drawn) kfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, karzitaH -tA -taM. — (Incited) pravarttitaH -tA -taM, prayojitaH -tA -taM, niyojitaH -tA -taM, protsAhitaH &c., pravfttaH -ttA -ttaM. — (Excited to pity) jAtakAruRyaH -RyA -RyaM, jAtadayaH -yA -yaM, dayAspfzwahfdayaH -yA -yaM. — (Affected) spfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, upahataH -tA -taM. — (Agitated) kzubDaH -bDA -bDaM, kzoBitaH -tA -taM.

MOVEMENT: I Lit.:(1) gatiH: v. Motion; (2) calanam, the earth moves with his m.: calane'vaniScalati tasya, Ki. xii. 28.;(3) cAraH, pra-, (rare), by the rapid m. of the ball: kandukasya SIGrapracAratayA, D. vi.;(4) BramaRam (= going round), circular m.: maRqalaBramaRam, D.II. Trans., moving: cAlanam, m. of the limbs: aNgacAlanam.III Agitation, commotion: q. v. IV In music: mUrcCanA.

MOVEMENT , s. calanaM, saraRaM, cAraH, caraRaM, saYcaraRaM, gatiH f., gamanaM, gamaH, copanaM, cezwA, cezwitaM, iNgitaM, sTAnAntaraM, sTalAntaraM, sTAnAntaragamanaM, sTAnaBedaH. — (Agitation) kzoBaH, kampaH. — (In music) grAmaH, tAlaH, mUrcCanA.
MOVER: i. e. proposer: prastAvakArin (f. RI) (?).

MOVER , s. (That which gives motion) cAlakaH, sArakaH, saYcArakaH. — (That which moves) caraH, calaH, calanaH. — (Proposer) upanyAsakft, karttavyopanyAsakft, karttavyopasTApakaH. — (One who impels to action) pravarttayitA m. (tf), pravarttakaH, prayojakaH, prerakaH.
MOVING (adj.): I Lit.: jaNgamaH (mA, maM), a m. capital: jaNgamarAjaDAnI, R. xvi. 26.: v. Move- -able.II Pathetic: hfdayaspfS (mfn.).

MOVING , a. (Exciting the affections) karuRAjanakaH -kA -kaM, kAru- RyotpAdakaH &c., dayAjanakaH &c., karuRAtmakaH &c., hfdayaveDakaH &c., hfdayaNgamaH -mA -maM, hfdayaspfk (S), marmmaspfk, hfdayaBedI -dinI -di (n), cittaveDakaH &c., cittadrAvakaH &c., BAvArdrakArI &c., cittArdrakArI &c.

MOVING , part. calan -lantI -lat (t), saran &c., caran &c., calaH -lA -laM, caraH -rA -raM, saraH -rA -raM, saraRaH -RA -RaM, calanaH -nA -naM, jaNgamaH -mA -maM, kampanaH -nA -naM, gatimAn -matI -mat (t), gAmI -minI &c., cArI &c., sArI &c., yAyI &c., sarpI &c., gatvaraH -rA -raM, mftvaraH -rA -raM; ‘moving in the air,’ AkASagAmI &c.
MOVINGLY: hfdayaM spfzwvA (?): v. Pathetically.
MOVINGLY , adv. yaTA hfdayaM spfSyate taTA, yaTA karuRA jAyate taTA, yaTA kAruRyam utpadyate taTA.
Mow, v. t. (dAtreRa) Cid 7 P; lU 9 P, do 4 P, kft 6 P. s. tfRa-DAnya-rASiH, tfRo-tkaraH, DAnyacayaH. [Mow]er, s. lAvakaH, tfRacCid m. [Mow]ing, s. tfRacCedaH, tfRakartanaM.
MOW. (v.): lunAti (lU, c. 9.): v. To cut.
MOW , s. (Of hay or grain) tfRarASiH m., DAnyarASiH m., DAnyacitiH f., DAnyacayaH, DAnyasaYcayaH, tfRotkaraH, DAnyotkaraH.
To MOW , v. a. dAtreRa or lavitreRa Cid (c. 7. Cinatti, CettuM) or avaCid or lU (c. 9. lunAti, lavituM) or kft (c. 6. kfntati, karttituM) or ava- kft, do or dA (c. 4. dyati, c. 2. dAti -tuM).
MOWED , MOWN, p. p. dAtraCinnaH -nnA -nnaM, dAtralUnaH -nA -naM, lavitraCinnaH &c., karttitaH -tA -taM, avakarttitaH &c., CinnaH &c., lUnaH &c.
MOWER: lAvakaH: v. Cutter.
MOWER , s. tfRaCedakaH, tfRaCid, tfRalavakaH, tfRalavitA m. (tf), nirdAtA m.
MOWING (subs.): (1) lavanam or lAvaH;(2) Cedanam (= cutting.).
MOWING , s. tfRaCedaH -danaM, tfRalavanaM, tfRakarttanaM, tfRalAvaH.
MR. (f. MRS): SrImat (f. tI).

Much, a. bahu, bahula, pracura, BUri, vipula, pra-, gAQa, atyaMta, nirBara, mahat, atyarTa, atirikta, utkawa, atimAtra, nitAMta, prAjya, puru, adaBra; gen. ex. by su, ati pr., atiSaya in comp. s. bahu n. or in comp., bAhulyaM, bahuBAgaH, BUyizWaM, BUyizWaBAgaH; ‘talking m(uch)’ bahuBAzin; ‘as m(uch) as’ tAvat-yAvat; ‘as m(uch) as may lie in oneʼs power’ yaTA-Sakti, yAvacCakyaM; ‘how m(uch)’ kiyat; ‘so m(uch)’, ‘this m(uch)’ iyat, etAvat; tAvat (as correlative of yAvat); ‘that m(uch)’ tAvat, ‘m(uch) more’, ‘m(uch) less’ kimuta, kimu, kiMpunaH. adv. bahu, BfSaM, atyaMtaM, BUri, gAQaM, nirBaraM, nitAMtaM, atimAtraM, su-ni-tarAM, balavat, ati-su- pr.; See Exceedingly.

MUCH (adj.): (1) bahu (f. hvI), showering too m. wealth on bards: vasUni varzan subahUni vandinAm, N. xv. 1.; with m. effort: bahuyatnena;(2) BUri- (mfn (= abundant: q. v.), m. fear: BUri Bayam, Ki.;(3) ati- (= excessive: q. v.), m. rain: ativfzwiH;(4) mahat (f. tI) (= great: q. v.), m. time: mahAn kAlaH, K.

MUCH (subs.): bahu (n.), one who eats m.: bahumoktA, At.: I have m. to ask about it: bahu prazwavyamatra, Mu.; men do not believe those who talk m.: bahuBAziRo na SraddaDAti lokaH, K. ; even this is too m. from him: etadeva tasmin bahutaram, Sa. iv.
MUCH (adv.): (1) bahu, we think m. of ourselves: AtmAnaM bahu manyAmahe vayam, Ku. vi. 20.;(2) ati (= greatly, exceedingly; q. v.), m. pleased: atiprItaH (tA, taM).
MUCH, AS, AS: yAvat (f. tI) tAvat (f. tI), gave as m. wealth as..: tAvadvasu dadO yAvat.., R. xvii. 17.; as m. as (lies) in one's power: yAvacCaktitaH, K.
MUCH, HOW: kiyat (f. tI), what thing and how m.: kiM vastu kiyadvA, R. v. 18.

MUCH, SO: I Abs:(1) iyat (f. tI), and for cooking so m. rice so m. fuel is sufficient: iyataScOdanasya pAkAyEtAvadinDanaM paryAptam, D. viii.; (2) etAvat (f. tI), if the motion of the moon is so m. in one day: yadyekena dinenEtAvatI candragatiH, Gan.II In correlation with as much: tAvat (f. tI). N.B. Use the neuter acc. sing. for adv.
MUCH, THAT: tAvat (f. tI), Ku. v. 10.

MUCH , a. bahuH -huH -hvI -hu, bahulaH -lA -laM, pracuraH -rA -raM, vipulaH -lA -laM, bahusaMKyakaH -kA -kaM, BUriH -riH -ri, BfSaH -SA -SaM, suBfSaH &c., gAQaH -QA -QaM, pragAQaH &c., vAQaH &c., udgAQaH &c., nirBaraH -rA -raM, BaraH, atyantaH -ntA -ntaM, atyarTaH -rTA -rTaM, atiriktaH -ktA -kta, ati- mAtraH -trA -traM, nitAntaH -ntA -ntaM, prAjyaH -jyA -jyaM, puzkalaH -lA -laM, BUyAn -yasI -yaH (s), BUyizWaH -zWA -zWaM, praBUtaH -tA -taM, utkawaH -wA -waM, puruH -ruH -ru, puruhaH -hA -haM, puruhuH -huH -hu, adaBraH -BrA -BraM, sPiraH -rA -raM, ativelaH -lA -laM, ati or atiSaya or su prefixed; as, ‘much pain,’ ativyaTA, atiSayavedanA; ‘much time,’ bahukAlaH, dIrTakAlaH; ‘as much,’ yAvAn -vatI -vat (t), yatiH -tiH -ti; ‘so much,’ tAvAn &c., etAvAn &c., iyAn -yatI &c., tatiH -tiH -ti; ‘so much time,’ tAvatkAlaM; ‘how much?’ kiyAn &c., kiyatpramARaH -RA -RaM, katiH -tiH -ti, katiTaH -TA -TaM, katipayaTaH &c.; ‘how much time?’ kiyatkAlaM, kiyantaM kAlaM.

MUCH , adv. bahu, BfSaM, BUri, gAQaM, nirBaraM, atyantaM, atiSayaM -yena, atyarTaM, nitAntaM, pragAQaM, udgAQaM, atimAtraM, ekAntatas, tIvraM, atitarAM, sutarAM, mahA in comp., sumahat, balavat, ati or atiSaya or su prefixed; [Page519-b+ 51] ‘as much,’ yAvat; ‘so much,’ tAvat, etAvat, tAvanmAtraM, iyat; ‘how much?’ kiyat, kati; ‘how much more?’ kimuta, kimpunar, sutarAM.

MUCH , s. bahutvaM, bAhulyaM, prAcuryyaM, BUyas n., bahuBAgaH; ‘much of what we know about the heavens, is founded on calculation,’ AkASIyajYAnamBUyo gaRitena jAyate; ‘to make much of,’ bahu man (c. 4. manyate, mantuM).

MUCH LESS, MUCH MORE: (1) kimuta, even my parents do not recognise me, m. less others: pitarAvapimAM na pratisaMvidAte kimutetaraH, D.: he is master even of my body, m. more of (my) house, of (my) fortune, and of (my) dependants: SarIrasyApyayameva praBuH, kimuta Bavanasya viBavasya parijanasya vA, K. ; (2) kimu, m. less kings: kimu rAjakam, Ki. ii. 43.; (3) kiM punar, m. more one who is so high: kiM punaryastaToccEH, Me.
MUCHNESS , s. bahutvaM -tA, bAhulyaM, prAcuryyaM, prAjyatA, pracuratA -tvaM, vipulatA.
Mucilage, s. medas n., vasA, vapA. 2 Slezman m., cikkaRavastu. Mucilaginous, a. cikkaRa, snigDa. 2 Slezmala-Ra.
MUCILAGE: no equiv.: rasaH may be used.
MUCILAGE , s. medas n., vasA, vapA, asTisnehaH, asTimedas n., kaPaH, SlezmA m. (n), SlezmakaH, cikkaRavastu n., meduravastu, snigDavastu

MUCILAGINOUS , a. cikkaRaH -RA -RaM, cikkiRaH -RA -RaM, meduraH -rA -raM, SlezmaRaH -RA -RaM, kaPamayaH -yI -yaM, kaPaguRakaH -kA -kaM, medasvI -svinI -svi (n), snigDaH -gDA -gDaM, SlepmalaH -lA -laM.

sanskrit.slp1: travad aBiDAvya yAn kAMScit sammuKIBUtajanAn aBihan
sanskrit.word: त्रवद् अभिधाव्य यान् कांश्चित् सम्मुखीभूतजनान् अभिहन्
sanskrit.iast: travad abhidhāvya yān kāṃścit sammukhībhūtajanān abhihan

details.body: Muck, s. purIzaM; See Dung. 2 malaM, kardamaH, kalkaM, ameDyaM, kaluzaM; ‘m(uck)-heap, or -hill’ malarASiH-saMcayaH, avakaranikaraH; ‘m(uck)-sweat’ atisvedaH, atyaMtaGarmaH, ‘m(uck)-worm’ paMkajaH, kIwaH. v. t. malena lip 6 P. [Muck]y, a. malina, samala, paMkila, ameDya.
MUCK: malam: v. Dirt, dung.

MUCK , s. (Dung) purIzaM, gomayaM, ameDyaM. — (Dirt) malaM, ameDyaM, paNkaH, kupaNkaH, kardamaH, kalkaM, jambAlaH -laM, kaluzaM; ‘To run a muck,’ unma- travad aBiDAvya yAn kAMScit sammuKIBUtajanAn aBihan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM).
To MUCK , v. a. ameDyena or malena lip (c. 6. limpati, leptuM), paNkena lip.
MUCK-HEAP, MUCK-HILL: malarASiH and sim. comp.s.
MUCK-HEAP , MUCK-HILL, s. ameDyarASiH m., malarASiH m., malasaYcayaH.
MUCK-SWEAT , s. BfSasvedaH, atisvedaH, nirBarasvedaH, atyantasvedaH.
MUCK-WORM , s. ameDyakIwaH, malajaH kIwaH, paNkajaH kfmiH.

MUCKY , a. samalaH -lA -laM, nalavAn -vatI -vat (t), malinaH -nA -naM, malamayaH -yI -yaM, paNkI -NkinI -Nki (n), malapaNkI &c., paNkilaH -lA -laM, ameDyaH -DyA -DyaM, kaluzI &c., sakardamaH -mA -maM.
MUCOUS: cikkaRaH (RA, RaM) (= slimy: ?). M. membrane: prob. jAlAni (n. pl.), “yErgavAkzita- midam SarIram” Bha.

MUCOUS , MUCULENT, a. (Slimy, like mucus) cikkaRaH -RA -RaM, ci- kkiRaH -RA -RaM, meduraH -rA -raM, SlezmaguRakaH -kA -kaM, kaPasaguRaH -RA -RaM, SlepmasaguRaH -RA -RaM, SlepmalaH -lA -laM, SlezmaRaH -RA -RaM, SlEzmikaH -kI -kaM. — (Seereting mucus) kaPotpAdakaH -kA -kaM, SlepmotpAdakaH &c., malotpAdakaH &c., kaPAdimalotpAdakaH &c., SlezmajanakaH -kA -kaM, SlezmakaraH -rA -raM, kaPakaraH &c.
MUCOUSNESS , s. SlezmatvaM, saSlezmatvaM, sakaPatvaM, cikkaRatA, meduratA.

Mucus, s. Slezman m., malaM, iMdriyamalaM; ‘m(ucus) of the nose’ siMGARaM, siMhARaM-naM, nAsA-malaM; ‘m(ucus) of the throat’ kaPaH, SlezmA; ‘m(ucus) of the bowels’ AmaH; ‘m(ucus) of the urethra’ puzpaM, ftuH Mucous, Muculent, a. cikkaRa; SlezmaRa-la, kaPa-saguRa. 2 Slezma-kaPa-kara (rI f.).

MUCUS , s. (Viscid substance secreted by a mucous membrane) SlezmA m. (n), SlezmAdimalaM, kaPAdimalaM, malaM, indriyamalaM; ‘of the nose,’ siMhAnaM, siMhARaM, siNGARaM -RakaM, SiNGARakaM, nAsAmalaM, nAsi kAmalaM; ‘of the throat,’ kaPaH, SlezmA m. (n), kledanaH, kledakaH ‘of the urethra, &c.,’ puzpikA ‘of the bowels,’ AmaH.

Mud, s. paMkaH-kaM, kardamaH, jaMbAlaH-laM, SAdaH, nizadvaraH. [Mud]dy, a. paMkila, sapaMka, paMkadUzita sakardama, malina, samala, malImasa; ‘m(uddy)-headed’ sTUla-jaqa-budDi, mftpiMqabudDi. Muddle, v. t. paMkilayati-kaluzayati-Avilayati (D.), duz c. (dUzayati), malinIkf 8 U, Avi-lIkf. 2 (Fig.) Akulayati (D.), Aku-lIkf, Izat muh c. or mad c.

MUD: (1) paNkaH, to remove m.: paNkaM harati, V. p. v. 10. 14.; stuck in deep m.: mahApaNke nimagnaH, H. (Also poet. of any turbid liquid, apUri paNkEriva kuNkumasya, N.);(2) kardamaH, thick m.: sAndrakardamaH, Ki.;(3) jambAlaH (mn (rare), this pond is reduced to m. jambAlaSezametat saraH saYjAtam, P. N.B. kardamaH is never applied by accurate writers to the mire of ponds etc.: comp. Bengali kAdA and pAM~ka .
MUD , s. paNkaH, kardamaH, jambAlaH -laM, jalakalkaH, nizadvaraH, cikilaH, SAdaH, parikzA, dalAQyaH, culukaH, vijapilaM, drApaH; ‘soft mud,’ paNkakarvawaH; ‘free from mud,’ nizpaNkaH -NkA -NkaM.
MUD-BUILT: (1) mArttikaH (kI, kaM);(2) by comp.: v. Earth.
MUD-WALL: mftkuqyam and sim. comp.s.
MUD-WALL , s. paNkaBittiH f., paNkanirmmitaH prAkAraH.
MUDDINESS: (1) paNkilatA;(2) sapaNkatA (rare); (3) kAluzyam (= foulness): m. of water: kAluzyamamBasaH, V. p. v. 10. 14.
MUDDINESS , s. paNkatA, sapaNkatA, paNkilatvaM, sakardamatA, sajambAlatA, kalu- zatA, kAluzyaM, samalatA, mAlinyaM, malavattvaM, AvilatvaM.
MUDDLE: I Lit.:(1) paNkilaM (f. lAM) karoti; (2) kaluzayati (nomi (= befoul: q v).II Fig., to confuse: Akulayati.III To be m.d = to be intoxicated: v. Drunk.

To MUDDLE , v. a. kaluza (nom. kaluzayati -yituM), malina (nom. mali- nayati -yituM), Avila (nom. Avilayati -yituM), duz (c. 10. dUzayati -yituM), kaluzIkf, samalIkf, malinIkf, AvilIkf. — (Intoxicate slightly) IzadunmattIkf, IzanmUQIkf.
MUDDLED , p. p. kaluzitaH -tA -taM, malinitaH -tA -taM, dUzitaH -tA -taM.
MUDDY: (1) paNkilaH (lA, laM);(2) sapaNka (f. NkA), from pond whose water was m.: sapaNkatoyAt sarasaH, Ri. i. 18.;(3) kaluzaH (zA, zaM) (= turbid, foul).

MUDDY , a. paNkilaH -lA -laM, paNkI -NkinI -Nki (n), sapaNkaH -NkA -NkaM, paNkamayaH -yI -yaM, bahupaNkaH -NkA -NkaM, pracurapaNkaH &c., sakardamaH -mA -maM, kArdamaH -mI -maM, sajambAlaH -lA -laM, malapaNkI &c., paNkaBArakaH -kA -kaM. — (Turbid, foul) kaluzaH -zA -zaM -zI -ziRI -zi (n), AvilaH -lA -laM, malinaH -nA -naM, samalaH -lA -laM, malavAn -vatI &c., malI- masaH -sA -saM, maladUzitaH -tA -taM.
MUDDY-HEADED , MUDDLE-HEADED, a. sTUlabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, jaqabudDiH &c.
Muff, s. lomamayaM hastatrARaM. 2 mUQaH, maMdaDIH.
MUFF: hastasamBAraH; UrRAmayaM hastatrARam.
MUFF , s. SItakAle strIlokaBftaM lomamayaM hastAcCAdanaM or hastAvaraRaM or hastatrARaM.
MUFFIN: pizwakaBedaH.
MUFFIN , s. SiTilapizwakaviSezo yo navanItAkto BUtvA KAdyate.
Muffle, v. t. (vastreRa) avaguMW 10, pari-A-vezw 1 A or c., AcCad 10, avaruD 7 U, baMD 9 P, prAvf 5 U; See Cover. [Muffl]er, s. AcCAdanaM, avaguMWanaM, muKAcCAdanaM.
MUFFLE: avaguRWayati (guRW, c. 10.): v. To wrap, cover, conceal.

To MUFFLE , v. a. muKagrIvAdi vastreRa banD (c. 9. baDnAti, bandDuM) or Avf (c. 5. -vfRoti -varituM -rItuM) or AcCad (c. 10. -CAdayati -yituM) or avaruD (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM) or parivezw (c. 1. -vezwate -zwituM,) c. 10. -vezwayati -yituM) or Avezw.
MUFFLED , p. p. vastrabadDaH -dDA -dDaM, vastraparivezwitaH -tA -taM, vastrAvarudDaH &c., vastrAcCAditaH -tA -taM, vastrAvftaH -tA -taM, AcCannaH -nnA -nnaM, samAcCannaH &c.
MUFFLER: (1) avaguRWanam, let me remove your m.: apanezyAmi tAvatte'vaguRWanam, Sa.;(2) aMSukam (when the sense is clear), Ki. ix. 24.
MUFFLER , s. muKAcCAdanaM, muKAvaraRaM, muKAcCAdanavastraM, muKAvaguRwanaM.
Mug, s. pAnapAtraM-BAjanaM, kaMsaH, jalapAtraM-BAjanaM.
MUG , s. pAnapAtraM, pAnaBAjanaM, kAMsyaM, kaMsaH -saM, kaMSaH, kAMSyaM, mftkAMsyaM, jalapAtraM, jalaBAjanaM, jalADAraH.
Muggy, Muggish, a. klinna, klinnanirvAta.
MUGGY: we have m. weather now: aDunA sarasA api nirvAtatayA tApakarA divasAH.
MUGGY , MUGGISH, a. uzRaklinnaH -nnA -nnaM, ArdragrIzmaH -zmA -zmaM, Ardra- nirvAtaH -tA -taM, klivaMnirvAtaH -tA -taM.
Mulberry, s. tU(nU)daH, yUpaH, kramukaH, brahmaRyaH, brahmadAru n.
MULBERRY: I The tree: nUdaH or tUtaH.II The fruit: nUdam or tUtam, Bha.
MULBERRY , s. nUdaH, pUzaH, kramukaH, brahmadAruH m., pAhAtaH, waNkAnakaH.
Mulct, s. daMqaH, arTa-Dana-daMqaH. v. t. daMq 10. daMqaM dA c. (dApayati).
MULCT: I Subs: arTadaRqaH: v. Fine.II Verb: v. To fine.
MULCT , s. daRqaH, DanadaRqaH, arTadaRqaH, paRaH, sAhasaM, daRqaleSaH.
To MULCT , v. a. daRq (c. 10. daRqayati -yituM), DanaM dA in caus. (dApa- yati -yituM), sAD (c. 10. sADayati -yituM), daRqaM praRI (c. 1. -Rayati -RetuM)

MURDERER: GAtakaH, secret m.: upAMSuGAtakaH, Vri.: v. Killer.

MURDERER , s. dvezapUrvvaM or dvezabudDyA hantA m. (ntf) or nihantA m. or GAtakaH or GAtI m. (n) or baDakaH, baDakArI m., baDodyataH, mArakaH, prARahantA m., jIvahantA m., hatyAkft, prARahatyAkft, AtatAyI m. (n), naraGAtI m., GnaH in comp., hA m. (n) in comp.; ‘of a brother,’ BrAtfhA m., BrAtfGnaH, BrAtfGAtakaH &c.; ‘of one asleep,’ suptaGAtakaH.

MURDEROUS: I Accompanied with murder: expr. by circumlo: v. Also bloody, cruel. II Intending murder:(1) hantukAmaH (mA, maM), of m. intent: hantukAmabudDiH, Mr. ix.;(2) jiGAMsu (mfn.), the m. beast: jiGAMsurmfgaH, Ki. xiv. 14. Ph.: in m. works: mAraRAtmakezu SAstrezu, K.

MURDEROUS , a. (Committing murder) GAtakaH -kA -kaM, GAtukaH -kA -kaM, GAtI -tinI -ti (n), baDakArI &c., prARaGAtakaH &c., vyApAdakaH -kA -kaM, prARAntakaH &c., jIvAntakaH &c., prARanASakaH &c. — (Pre- meditating murder, intending it) baDEzI -ziRI &c., baDodyataH -tA -taM, jiGAMsuH -suH -su, baDABisanDiH -nDiH -nDi, hiMsAbudDiH -dDiH -dDi, sannadDaH -dDA -dDaM. — (Consisting in murder) mArAtmakaH -kA -kaM, AtyayikaH -kI -kaM.
MURDEROUSLY: (1) dArURam (= ferociously); (2) nizWuram (= cruelly).
MURIATE , s. (Of mercury) rasakarzpUraH, rasapuzpaM.
MURK , s. anDakAraH, tamas n., timiraM, tamisraM, meGatimiraM, sABratA.
MURKY: tAmasaH (sI, saM): v. Dark, gloomy.
MURKY , a. sAnDakAraH -rA -raM, satimiraH -rA -raM, tamasvI -svinI -svi (n), tamomayaH -yI -yaM, tamovftaH -tA -taM, meGAcCannaH -nnA -nnaM, sABraH -BrA -BraM, malinaH -nA -naM.

Murmur, s. maMdaDvaniH-ravaH, marmaraDvaniH, kala-ravaH-svanaH-rutaM, kalakalaH guMjitaM, gaMBIranAdaH; ‘m(urmur) of applause’ praRAdaH. 2 aMtar-gUQa-vilApaH, asaMtozaDvaniH. v. i. asaMtozaRa-savizAdaM-sanirvedaM-vilap 1 P or pari-dev 1 A or paridiv 10 A. 2 guMj 1 P, kalaM-maMdaM-gaMBIraM-ru 2 P. 3 jap 1 P, nIcEH vad 1 P. [Murmur]er, s. asaMtuzwajanaH, sadAvilApin m.
MURMUR (subs.): I A low sound: kalakalaH. II A complaint: utkroSaH (= cry: q. v.).
MURMUR (v.): I To make a low sound: kalakalaM karoti.II To grumble: q. v.: KiwaKiwAyate (nomi.) (?).

MURMUR , s. (Low sound) kalakalaH, kalaH, kalaravaH, kalarutaM, kalasvaraH -raM, mandarutaM, mandarAvaH, rutaM, rAvaH, guYjitaM, guYjanaM, marmaraH, maRitaM, stanitaM, JaNkAraH, raRatkAraH, raRaraRaSabdaH, garjanaM, garjitaM, mandraSabdaH, gamBIraSabdaH, mandraDvaniH m., gamBIraDvaniH m., AmandraSabdaH, nIcaSabdaH; ‘murmur of applause,’ praRAdaH, praRadanaM. — (Suppressed sound of complaint) antarvilApaH, antarvilapitaM, gUQavilApaH, gUQaparidevanaM -nA, antaHparidevanA, asantozasUcakaSabdaH, asantozArTakaSabdaH.

To MURMUR , v. n. (Make a low sound) kalakalaSabdaM kf, guYj (c. 1. guYjati -YjituM), garj (c. 1. garjati -rjituM), garjanaM kf, gamBIraM or mandraSabdena ru (c. 2. rOti, ravituM) or viru or aBiru or stan (c. 1. stanati -nituM), gamBIrastanitaM kf, gamBIraSabdaM kf, nIcaSabdaM kf, mandraSabdaM kf, AmandraSabdaM kf, Gur (c. 6. Gurati -rituM), raRaraRaSabdaM kf. — (Mutter) jap (c. 1. japati -pituM), prajap, nIcasvareRa vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), nIcEr vad, upAMSu vad. — (Make a sound of complaint) asanto- zAd vilap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM) or paridev (c. 1. -devate -vituM), asanto- zasUcakaSabdaM kf, asantozArTakaSabdaM kf, vivad (c. 1. -vadate -dituM).
MURMURER , s. asantuzwatvAt sadAparidevI m. (n) or sadAvilApI m., asantuzwajanaH, vivAdI m. (n).
MURMURING , s. (Low sound) garjanaM, parigarjanaM. See MURMUR.
MURMURING , part. (Making a low sound) guYjan -YjantI -Yjat (t), kalakalaSabdakArI -riRI -ri (n), mandraSabdakArI &c.
Murrain, s. mArI, mahAmArI.
MURRAIN: paSUnAM mArI (?).
MURRAIN , s. gavAdijantumArI, gavAdimArakaH, mArI, mahAmArI.
Muscle, s. snAyu f.; mAMsapeSI, snasA, vasnasA, peSI, SirA. 2 SaMbUkaH. Muscular, Musculous, a. snAyusaMbaMDin. 2 mAMsala, dfQAMga (gI f.), upacitagAtra.
MUSCLE: I Of the body: peSI, mAMsa-, Bha. II A kind of fish: SambUkaviSezaH.

MUSCLE , s. snAyuH m., snasA, peSI, SirA, mAMsapeSI, mAMsaSirA, mAMsarajjuH m. f., vasnAsA, vahIruH m., sanDibanDanaM, granTibanDanaM; ‘trapezium muscle,’ manyA, manyAkA. — (Shell-fish) SambuH, SambukaH, SambUkaH.
MUSCULAR: I Pertaining to muscles: by comp. or gen., m. action: peSInAM karma, Bha. II Strong, powerful: q. v.: mAMsalaH (lA, laM).
MUSCULAR , MUSCULOUS, a. (Pertaining to a muscle) snAyusambanDI -nDinI &c.; ‘muscular action,’ cAlanaM. — (Brawny, strong) mAMsalaH -lA -laM, snAyumAn -matI -mat (t), dfQANgaH -NgI -NgaM, balavAn &c.
Muse, v. i. DyE 1 P, ciMt 10, vimfS 6 P, vicar c.; See Meditate. s. DyAnaM, ciMtA. 2 vAgdevI, sarasvatI, vidyADizWAtrI, vidyA-devatA. [Muse]ful, a. ciMtA or DyAna-para-SIla-nizWa.
MUSE (subs.): I Meditation: DyAnam.II Goddess of learing: vidyAdevI (?).
MUSE (v.): DyAyati (DyE, c. 1.): v. To medi- -tate, think.
MUSE , s. vidyAdevI, kAvyadevatA, vAgdevatA, vidyADizwAtrI, kAvyADizwAtrI, sarasvatI. — (Deep thought) DyAnaM, cintA.

To MUSE , v. n. cint (c. 10. cintayati -yituM), DyE (c. 1. DyAyati, DyAtuM), sanDyE, vimfS (c. 6. -mfSati -mrazwuM), vicar (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM), man (c. 4. manyate, mantuM), cintAM kf, DyAnanizWaH -zWA -zWaM BU, cintAparaH -rA -raM BU.
MUSEFUL , a. DyAnanizWaH -zWA -zWaM, DyAnaparaH -rA -raM, cintAparaH &c.
Museum, s. kOtukAgAraM, durlaBavastusaMgrahaH.
MUSEUM: *kOtukAgAram and sim. comp.s.
MUSEUM , s. kOtukAgAraM, kOtukAlayaH, kOtukasaNgrahAlayaH, kOtukasaNgraha- sTAnaM, durlaBadravyAgAraM, durlaBavastusaNgrahasTAnaM, AScaryyapadArTAlayaH.
Mushroom, s. CatraM, CatrakaH; See Fungus. a. acirasTAyin, kzaRaDvaMsin, utpadyEva, vilIyamAna.
MUSHROOM: (1) Catram, -trA;(2) CatrakaH;(3) CatrAkaH.
MUSHROOM , s. CatraM -trA, CatrAkaM, CatrakaH, CatrikA, atiCatraH -trakaH, ucCilInDraM -nDrakaM, SilInDraM -nDrakaM, pAlaGnaH, UrvyaNgaM, mallipatraM, dilIraH.

Music, s. gItaM, saMgItaM, saMgIta or vAdya-vidyA or SAstraM (‘science of m(usic)’). 2 (Melody) tAlEkyaM, svarAnupUrvyaM, susvanaH-svaraH, mADuryaM; tOryaM, vAdyaGozaH; ‘vocal m(usic)’ saMgItaM; ‘instrumental m(usic)’ vAdanaM; ‘set to m(usic)’ svara-tAla-badDa; ‘m(usic)-room’ saMgItaSAlA; ‘fond of m(usic)’ nAdalubDa. [Music]al, a. saMgItavizayaka, gAnIya, (s.) in comp. 2 susvara, suSrAvya; See Melodious. 3 saMgIta-gAna-priya, nAdapriya-lubDa-Asakta, vAdanaSIla-Asakta; ‘m(usical) entertainment’ gAnotsavaH; ‘m(usical) instrument’ vAditraM, vAdyaM; ‘m(usical) glasses’ jalataraMgaH. [Music]ally, adv. susvaraM, saMgIta SAstrAnurUpaM. [Music]ian, s. gAyakaH, gAtf m., gATakaH. 2 vAdakaH, vAditrakuSalaH, saMgItajYaH, susvarABijYaH.

MUSIC: I The art:(1) saNgItam, m. -room: saNgIta- SAlA, Sa.;(2) gItam (= vocal m.), learnt vocal and instrumental m.: gItaM vAditraYca pratyavindat, Mah.;(3) vAdyam or vAditram (= instrumental m.);(4) gAnDarvam, to hear m.: gAnDarvaM Srotum, Mr. iii.; one who knows m.: gAnDarvajYaH, K. s. xi. 11.II Melody, harmony:(1) mUrcCanA or mArjanA (= succession of modulated sounds), Si. i. 10.;(2) svanaH (= sound), m. of lyre: tantrIsvanaH, Mr.;(3) mADuryam (= sweetness).

MUSIC , s. (The art or science) ganDarvavidyA or ganDarbavidyA, susvaravidyA, ganDarvavedaH, saNgItavidyA, vAdanavidyA, vAdyavidyA, susvaraSAstraM, saNgIta- SAstraM, saNgItavyApAraH, vijYAnaM. — (Harmony, melody) susvaraH, susvarasaNgaH, susvaratA, vAdyaGozaH, kalatA -tvaM, tOryyaM, tAlaH; ‘vocal and instrumental music,’ saNgItaM -tiH f., gItavAdanaM; ‘music with singing and dancing,’ tOryyatrikaM; ‘set to music,’ svarabadDaH -dDA -dDaM; ‘fond of music,’ susvarAnandI -ndinI &c., nAdalabDaH -bDA -bDaM; ‘music-room,’ saNgItaSAlA. For the seven notes of music See GAMUT.
MUSICAL: I Relating to music: expr. by comp., in the special m. works: gAnDarvavedaviSezezu, K.II. Fond of m.: saNgItapriyaH (yA, yaM) and sim. comp.s.III Melodious, sweet: maDuraH (rA, raM).

MUSICAL , a. (Belonging to music) ganDarvavidyAsambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), saNgItavidyAsambanDI &c., susvaravidyAsambanDI &c., susvaravizayaH -yA -yaM, susvaraSAstrasambanDI &c., sOvaraH -rI -raM, gAnIyaH -yA -yaM. — (Harmonious, melodious) susvaraH -rA -raM, suSrAvyaH -vyA -vyaM, susva- rayuktaH -ktA -ktaM. — (Fond of music) susvarapriyaH -yA -yaM, susvarAnandI &c., vAdyapriyaH &c., vAdanaSIlaH -lA -laM, nAdapriyaH &c., nAdalubDaH -bDA -bDaM, nAdAsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, vAdanAsaktaH &c., vAdyaSravaRAsaktaH &c.; ‘musical instrument,’ vAditraM, vAdyaM, tUryyaM, tAlitaM, AtodyaM, BARqaM; ‘playing on musical instruments,’ vAdyavAdanaM, BARqavAdanaM; ‘musical glasses,’ jalataraNgaH.
MUSICALLY: maDuram, Mr.: v. Melodiously, sweetly.
MUSICALLY , adv. susvaraM -reRa, susvarapUrvvaM, susvaravidyAnusAreRa.
MUSICIAN: (1) gAnDarvajYa (f. jYA);(2) gItakovidaH (dA, daM) (vocal), Mah.

MUSICIAN , s. (One that plays on an instrument) vAdakaH, vAdya- vAdakaH, vAditravAdakaH, BARqavAdakaH, vAdanakarttA m. (rttf), BARqikaH. — (Singer) gATakaH, gATikaH, gAyakaH, gAtA m. (tf), gATAkAraH. — (One skilled in music) vAdanakuSalaH, vAditrakuSalaH, susvaravidyAjYaH, saNgItavidyAtattvajYaH, gAnDarvatattvajYaH; ‘celestial musician,’ ganDarbaH, names for some of these are tumburuH m., viSvAvasuH, citraraTaH; the last is their chief. See GANDHARBA.
MUSING , part. or a. DyAyan -yantI -yat (t), cintayan &c. See MUSEFUL.

Musk, s. kastUrI, kastUrikA, mfganABiH, mfgamadaH, nABi m. f., gaMDaDUli f., vAtAmodA, aMqajA; ‘m(usk)-deer’ gaMDamfgaH, kastUrImfgaH; ‘m(usk)-rat’ gaMDamUzakaH, gaMDAKuH. [Musk]y, a. kastUrIyukta, mfganABigaMDi, kastUrIvAsita.
MUSK: (1) kastUrI;(2) mfganAmiH;(3) mfgamadaH. M.-bag.:(1) kastUrImallikA;(2) mfgamadavAsA; (3) aRqaH,-Rqam (when the sense is clear), Kuv.

MUSK , s. kastUrI -rikA, kasturikA, kastUrikARqajaH, mfganABiH m., mfgamadaH, mfganABijaM -jA, mfgARqajA, aRqajA, nABiH -BI f., madaH, darpaH, madAhvaH, madAraH, ganDaDUliH f., ganDacelikA, yojanaganDA, ganDaSeKaraH, vAtAmodA, mArgaH, lalitA; ‘musk-bag,’ aRqaM, mfgARqaM, kastUrImallikA.
MUSK-DEER: kastUrImfgaH (?) or kastUrikAmfgaH, Kuv.
MUSK-DEER , s. kastUrImfgaH, ganDamfgaH, mfgapAlikA, ganDavAhaH.
MUSK-MELON: KarbUjam, Bha.
MUSK-RAT: ganDamUzikaH; ganDAKuH.
MUSK-RAT , s. ganDamUzikaH -kA, ganGAKuH m., ganDanakulaH, ganDaSuRqinI, ganDASuRqinI, ganDasUyI, ganDasuKI, cikkaH, puMvfzaH.
Musket, s. AgneyanAli-lI f. gulikA-prakzepiRI.
MUSKET: bandukaH, m.-ball: *bandukaguliH
MUSKET , s. AgneyanAqiH -qI, gulikAprakzepaRI, guwikAprakzepaRI, guli- kAprakzepaRI suziranAlI; ‘musket-ball,’ gulikA, guwikA, guliH f.
MUSKETEER: *bandukaBft (mfn.); *bandukaDArin (f. RI); etc.
MUSKETRY: *bandukAH (m. pl.), fire of m.: bandukAgniH.
MUSKY , a. kastUrIganDayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, kastUrIvAsitaH -tA -taM, kastUrIganDa- vAn -vatI -vat (t), mfgamadasaganDaH -nDA -nDaM, suganDiH -nDiH -nDi.
Muslin, a. sUkzmavastraM, sUkzmAMSukaM, aMSukaM.
MUSLIN: *mammalam (comp. Bengali malmal).
MUSLIN , s. aMSukaM, sUkzmAMSukaM, dukUlaM, sUkzmadukUlaM, sUkzmavastraM.
MUSQUITO , MUSKETO, s. maSakaH, maSaH, masakaH, sUkzmamaSakaH, sUkzmamakzikA, BamBarAlikA, sUcivadanaH, raRaraRaH, kawukIwaH, rAtrijAgaradaH, prAcikA; ‘musquito-curtain,’ maSaharI, catuzkI.
MUSSULMAN: *mahammadaDarsAvalambin (f. nI); mahammadIyaH (yA, yaM).
MUSSULMAN , s. yavanaH, yAvanaH, yAvanadeSIyaH, yAvanamataDArI m. (n), yAvanaDarmmAvalambI m. (n).

Must, v. ex. by pot. pass. part. with or without avaSyaM, niyataM, nUnaM; ‘I m(ust) worship god’ (avaSyaM) mayeSvaraH pUjanIyaH, ‘he m(ust) have now come home’ aDunA tena gfhamAgatena BavitavyaM; oft. by arh 1 P; ‘he m(ust) be honoured’ mAnamarhatyeva; ‘it m(ust) be so’ evaM Kalu tatsyAt, evaM nAma. s. drAkzArasaH. v. i. virasIBU 1 P. [Must]y, a. virasa, niHsAra; durgaMDa.
MUST (subs.): drAkzAnizpIqitaM navamadyam.

MUST (v.): (1) avaSyam with future pass. part, if (you) m. go: avaSyaM yadi gantavyam, P. ; you m. tell (me) the reason: tvayAvaSyaM kAraRaM vaktavyam, Vet.; what m. come to pass: avaSyaBavyaH (vyA, vyaM), N.;(2) niyamena (rare) with same cons., I m. kill (him): niyamena mayA nivarhaRIyaH, Ki.: v. Also should.

MUST , v. n. (Be necessitated). Expressed by the fut. pass. part.; as, ‘anger must be restrained,’ kopo niyantavyaH; ‘I must go, or it is to be gone by me.’ mayA gantavyaM; ‘I must do that,’ tan mayA karttavyaM or karaRIyaM or kAryyaM. The adverb avaSyaM may be added; as, tan mayA avaSyaM karttavyaM. Sometimes the verb arh (c. 1. arhati -rhituM) has the sense of ‘must;’ as, ‘he must not receive that,’ na tat prAptum arhati.
MUST s. (Wine just pressed from the grape) navamadyaM, nUtanamadyaM.
To MUST , v. n. (Grow mouldy and sour) amlIBU, durganDIBU, virasIBU.
MUSTACHE , MUSTACHIO, MUSTACHES, s. pl. gumPaH, ozWaloma n. (n), ozWalomAni n. pl., ozWajaM loma n. or roma, ozWajaloma n., SmaSru n., pakzma n. (n), pakzmARi n. pl.
Mustaches, Mustachio, s. SmaSru n., guMPaH, ozWaloman n.
Mustard, s. sarzapaH, taM(tu)tuBaH, kadaMbakaH; ‘black m(ustard)’ kfzRikA, rAjikA, kzavaH, kzutA(DA)BijananaH, AsurI, rAjasarzapaH; ‘white m(ustard)’ sidDArTaH-rTakaH.
MUSTARD: sarzapaH, m.-oil: sarzapatElam, Sr. Black m.: kfzRikA, rAjikA (rare), P. White m.: sidDArTakaH.

MUSTARD , s. (Plant) sarzapaH, rAjasarzapaH, sarizapaH, kawukaH, kawusnehaH, kadambakaH -kaM, kadambadaH, vimbawaH, KaYjanA; ‘black mustard,’ kfzRikA, rAjikA, AsurI, kzavaH, kzuDABijananaH, kzutABijananaH; ‘white mustard,’ sidDArTaH -rTakaH; ‘mustard-seed,’ sarzapavIjaM, tantuBaH, tantukaH; ‘oil expressed from it,’ sarzapatElaM; ‘used for seasoning,’ upaskaraH; ‘made of mustard,’ sArzapaH -pI -paM.
MUSTARD-POT , s. sarzapapAtraM, sarzapatElapAtraM, sarzapaBAjanaM, sarzapADAraH.

Muster, v. t. saMgrah 9 P, samA-hf 1 P, samA-nI 1 P, saM-Uh 1 U; samAhve 1 P, ekIkf 8 U, saMgam c., (gamayati). 2 (sEnikAn) parisaMKyA 2 P or parigaR 10, ekatra samAnI. v. i. saM-i 2 P, saMmil 6 P, saMgam 1 A; See Assemble; ‘m(uster)-roll’ nAmA-vali-lI f., parisaMKyA, parigaRanA.
MUSTER (v. t.): samAharati (hf, c. 1.): v. To collect.
MUSTER (v. i.): (1) samAgacCati (gam, c. 1.); (2) samEti (i, c. 2.).

To MUSTER , v. a. samAnI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), samUhIkf, ekatra kf, ekatra saNgam (c. 10. -gamayati -yituM) or samAgam, ekIkf, samUh (c. 1. -Uhate -hituM), samAhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), samAhve (c. 1. -hvayati -hvAtuM), saNgrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM), saNgrahaM kf. — (Assemble or call over soldiers) sEnyAn saMKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM) or parisaMKyA or sampa- riKyA or parigaR (c. 10. -gaRayati -yituM), sEnyanAmAni pfTak pfTak KyA, sEnyAn ekatra samAnI.
To MUSTER , v. n. saNgam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), samAgam, ekatra Agam, same (samEti -tuM, rt. i), sammil (c. 6. -milati -melitaM), ekatra mil, samAvft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), samUhIBU.
MUSTER-ROLL: *saMKyAnapatrikA and sim. comp.s.
MUSTER-ROLL , s. sEnyaparisaMKyA -KyAnaM, sEnyaparigaRanA, sEnyanAmAvaliH f., saMKyA.
MUSTINESS: kAluzyam: v. Foulness.
MUSTINESS , s. virasatA, vErasyaM, paryyuzitatvaM, pUtiganDatA, durganDatA.
MUSTY: kaluzitaH (tA, taM): v. Foul.
MUSTY , a. virasaH -sA -saM, paryyuzitaH -tA -taM, pUtiganDikaH -kA -kaM.
MUTABILITY: parivfttiSIlatA, etc.: v. Also in- -constancy.

MUTABILITY , MUTABLENESS, s. asTiratA, asTEryyaM, asTAyitvaM, aDIratA, aDftiH f., sTEryyABAvaH, vikAraSIlatA, pariRAmaSIlatA. — (Fickle- ness) caYcalatvaM, cAYcalyaM, capalatA, cApalyaM, calacittatA, lolatA, anavasTitiH f.

Mutable, a. vikAravat, asTira, parivartanIya, vikAraSIla, aniyata, anavasTita, asTAyin, vyayin. 2 lola, caMcala, tarala; See Fickle. [Mutable]ness, Mutability, s. asTEryaM, vyayitA, vikAraSIlatA, parivfttikzamatA, anavasTiti f. 2 lOlyaM, cAMcalyaM, taralatA. Mutation, s. pariRAmaH, vikfti f., vikAraH, vikriyA, sTiti-avasTA-BedaH.
MUTABLE: (1) parivfttiSIlaH (lA, laM);(2) vikAravat (f. tI) (gen. for the worse);(3) anavasTitaH (tA, taM) (= inconstant, fickle: q. v.).

MUTABLE a. asTiraH -rA -raM, asTAyI -yinI -yi (n), aDIraH -rA -raM, anavasTaH -sTA -sTaM, anavasTitaH -tA -taM, pariRAmaSIlaH -lA -laM, vikA- raSIlaH &c., pariRAmasvaBAvaH -vA -vaM, aniyataH -tA -taM. — (Fickle) caYcalaH -lA -laM, capalaH -lA -laM, calacittaH -ttA -traM, lolaH -lA -laM, caYcalavfttiH -ttiH -tti, capalavfttiH &c., kzaRikabudDiH -dDiH -dDi.
MUTATION , s. vikAraH, vikftiH f., vikriyA, pariRAmaH, vipariRAmaH, parivarttaH -rttanaM, anyaTABAvaH, avasTAntaraM, avasTABedaH, sTitiBedaH.

Mute, a. mUka, jaqa, jaqavAc, vAkSUnya, avAc, vARIhIna, niHSabda, mudritamuKa; ‘m(ute) with wonder’ AScaryajaqIkfta. s. mUkajanaH, mUkaH. 2 pakzipurIzaM. [Mute]ly, adv. niHSabdaM, mUkavat, jaqavat. [Mute]ness, s. mUkatA, jAqyaM, vAgaBAvaH, vAkstaMBaH, mOna-mUka-BAvaH.
MUTE (adj.): mUkaH (kA, kaM), with the birds m.: mUkARqajam, Ku. iii. 42.: v. Dumb, speech- -less.
MUTE (subs.): I Of birds: purIzam, R.: v. Dung.II A consonant: *mUkaH (kA, kaM). [Page464] III An attendant at a funeral: mfta- paricArakaH (?).
MUTE (v.): I To cast off: utsfjati (sfj, c. 6.).II To dung: purIzamutsfjati.

MUTE , a. mUkaH -kA -kaM, jaqavAk m. f. n. (c), jaqaH -qA -qaM, vAkSUnyaH -nyA -nyaM, vAgrahitaH -tA -taM, vAkSaktihInaH -nA -naM, vARIhInaH -nA -naM, vARIrahitaH -tA -taM, niHSabdaH -bdA -bdaM, niSSabdaH &c., nAdaSUnyaH &c., mudritamuKaH -KA -KaM, nirvacanaH -nA -naM, avAk (c), anuttaraH -rA -raM, niruttaraH -rA -raM.
MUTE , s. (Person who cannot speak) mUkajanaH. — (In grammar) svarasahitoccAryavyaYjanaM. — (Dung of birds) pakzipurIzaM, pakziBir uccaritaM malaM, gUTaH.
To MUTE , v. n. pakzivat purIzam utsfj (c. 6. -sfjati -srazwuM), purIzotsargaM kf.
MUTELY: (1) mukavat;(2) niHSabdam.
MUTELY , adv. mUkavat, jaqavat, mUkaM, niHSabdaM, niruttaraM, tUzRIM.
MUTENESS , s. mUkatA, mOkyaM, vAkSUnyatA, vAgrAhityaM, jaqatA, vAgjAqyaM, vAkstamBaH, vAgroDaH, vAgaBAvaH, niHSabdatA, avAktvaM, aBAzaRaM, mOnaM, mOnaBAvaH.

Mutilate, v. t. vyaMgIkf 8 U, vikalIkf; (aMgAni) KaMq 10, vyavacCid 7 P, kft 6 P. [Mutilat]ed, a. vikalAMga (gI f.), kzatavikzata, CinnaBinna, KaMqitAMga, KaMqitavigraha, nazWeMdriya. [Mutilat]ion, s. vyaMgIkaraRaM, vyavacCedaH-danaM, KaMqanaM, aMgakartanaM. 2 nyUnAMgatA, vyaMgatA, vEkalyaM.

MUTILATE: I Lit.: vyaNgIkaroti, why you m.d your wife: kimarTaM tvayA BAryA vyaNgitA, P. i. 4. II Fig.: Perh. vikalIkaroti, “m.d poets”: vikalIkftakavayaH; the Vyaktiviveka and Ālochana are here only in a m.d form: vyaktivivekAlocana- granTAvatra KaRqitAveva staH, Mahesha.

To MUTILATE , v. a. vyavaCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), aNgaCedanaM kf, vraSc (c. 6. vfScati, vraScituM), pravraSc, bahuKaRqaSaH kf or Cid, bahuKaRqIkf, KaRqaM KaRqaM kf, KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati -yituM), vinikft (c. 6. -kfntati -karttituM), kzatavikzatIkf, CinnaBinnIkf, vikalIkf, vikalANgIkf, vyaNgIkf, viSas (c. 1. -Sasati -situM), aNgavEkalyaM kf.

MUTILATED , p. p. CinnaBinnaH -nnA -nnaM, kzatavikzataH -tA -taM, vyavaCinnaH &c., vyavaCinnANgaH -NgA -NgaM, lUnANgaH &c., CinnANgaH &c., vikalANgaH &c., vikalIkftaH -tA -taM, KaRqitaH -tA -taM, KaRqitANgaH &c., KaRqitavigrahaH -hA -haM, nyUnANgaH &c., hInANgaH &c., aNgahInaH -nA -naM, apANgaH &c., vikalendriyaH -yA -yaM, nazwendriyaH &c.
MUTILATION: I The act: vyaNgIkaraRam.II The state: vEkalyam.III Of works: *vikalI- karaRam.

MUTILATION , s. (The act) vyavacCedaH -danaM, aNgacCedaH -danaM, vikalIkaraRaM, vyaNgIkaraRaM, aNgakarttanaM, vinikarttanaM, vraScanaM, KaRqanaM, viSasanaM. — (State) vikalatA, vEkalyaM, aNgavEkalyaM, aNgahInatA, nyUnANgatA, hInANgatA, apANgatA, lUnANgatA, KaRqitatvaM, KaRqitANgatA.
MUTINEER: vidrohin (f. RI) (?); antaHprakopa- kArin (f. RI) (?).
MUTINEER , s. AjYAlaNGI m. (n), SAsanalaNGI m., AjYAviroDI m., kalahakArI m., senAkzoBakArI m., senAyAM prakopakArI.
MUTINOUS: (1) vidrohajananaH (nI, naM) (?);(2) antaHprakopakaraH (rI, raM); etc.

MUTINOUS , a. AjYAlaNGI -NGinI -NGi (n), SAsanAviDAyI &c., avaSavarttI &c., kalahakArI &c., kzoBakArI &c., prakopakArI &c., pratIpaH -pA -paM, vipratIpaH -pA -paM, avaSaH -SA -SaM, duHSAsanaH -nA -naM, duHSAsyaH -syA -syaM, aviDeyaH -yA -yaM, anAyattaH -ttA -ttaM.

Mutiny, s. sEnyadrohaH-aparAgaH-virakti f. kzoBaH-prakopaH, saMkzoBaH, vyutTAnaM; ‘let him raise a m(utiny) in Jambudwipa’ jaMbudvIpe kopaM janayatu (H. 3). v. i. aBi-druh 4 P, prakopaM dfS c., virAgaM dfS c., kzuB 4 P, vyutTA 1 P, SAsanaM laMG 1 A, 10. [Mutin]eer, s. prakopakArin, AjYAlaMGin, aBi-vi-drohin, droha-kzoBa-kArin all m. [Mutin]ous, a. aMtaHprakopakara (rI f.), AjYAlaMGin, kzoBa-prakopa-kArin; pratIpa, avaSa, anAyatta, duHSAsya.
MUTINY (subs.): I Lit.:(1) sEnikavidrohaH (?);(2) sEnyaprakopaH (?).II Fig.: tumult, uproar: q. v.: saMramBaH.
MUTINY (v.): (1) vidrohaM karoti (?);(2) aDi- jAyate (jan, c. 4 (with loc.) (?), D. iii.

MUTINY , s. senAprakopaH, sEnyaprakopaH, senAkopaH, prakopaH, kopaH, senAkzoBaH, sEnyakzoBaH, SAsanalaNGanaM, AjYAlaNGanaM, kalahaH, sEnyakalahaH, sEnyavErAgyaM, sEnyaviraktiH f., SAsanavyutTAnaM, AjYAvyutTAnaM.

To MUTINY , v. n. kalaha (nom. kalahAyate), kalahaM kf, senApatiSAsanaM laNG (c. 10. laNGayati -yituM), pratIpa (nom. pratIpAyate), vyutTA (c. 1. -tizWati -TAtuM, rt. sTA), kopaM kf, prakopaM kf, kzoBaM kf, avaSIBU, anAyattIBU.

Mutter, v. asPuwaM-aspazwaM vad 1 P or jalp 1 P, avyaktaM uccar c., nIcEH vad; ‘m(utter) prayers’ jap 1 P. 2 garj 1 P, stan 1 P, gaMBIraM svan 1 P. [Mutter]ing, s. aspazwoccAraRaM, avyaktaBAzaRaM, upAMSuvAdaH-BAzitaM. 2 japaH, jApyaM, svADyAyaH. 3 garjitaM, stanitaM, nirGozaH. [Mutter]er, s. asPuwavAdin m., upAMSuvAdin m. [Mutter]ingly, adv. upAMSu, nIcEH, aspazwaM, avyaktaM.

MUTTER (v.): asPuwaM jalpati (jalp, c. 1.) (of men) and sim. comp.s., the sky looks sound- ing with m.ing thunder and rolling with wind: ambaraM vispazwASaninisvanena rasatIvAGUrRatIvAnilEH, Mr. v. 26.

To MUTTER , v. a. and n. (Utter words with a low indistinct voice) aspazwaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), aspazwavAcA vad, aspazwasvareRa vad, aspazwoccAraRena vad, avyaktaM vad, or uccar (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM), nIcavAcA or nIcasvareRa vad, nIcEr vad, jap (c. 1. japati -pituM), prajap; this last verb is applied especially to the muttering of prayers, though it may be used in other senses; as, ‘to mutter into the ear,’ karRe jap, karRam upajap. — (Sound with a low rumbling voice) garj (c. 1. garjati -rjituM), stana (c. 1. stanati -nituM), gamBIraSabdaM kf.

MUTTER , MUTTERING, s. (Uttering with a low voice) aspazwoccAraRaM, avyaktoccAraRaM, nIcaBAzaRaM, nIcavAkyaM, nIcasvareRa BAzaRaM, upAMSu vAdaH. — (Low rumbling sound) garjanaM, garjitaM, AmandraSabdaH, gamBI- raSabdaH; ‘of clouds,’ meGanirGozaH. — (Inaudible repetition of prayers, &c.) japaH, jApaH, japanaM, svADyAyaH, jApyaM, japajApyaM, upAMSuH m.
MUTTERED , p. p. upAMSu or aspazwaM or nIcavAcA uccAritaH -tA -taM, japitaH &c.; ‘to be muttered,’ japyaH -pyA -pyaM, jApyaH &c., japanIyaH -yA -yaM; ‘having muttered,’ japitvA.
MUTTERER , s. aspazwavAdI m. (n), nIcavAdI m., nIcaBAzI m., upAM- SuvAdI, jApakaH, japanakft m.; ‘a devotee who mutters,’ jaYjapUkaH.
MUTTERINGLY , adv. aspazwavAcA, nIcavAcA, upAMSu, nIcEs.
Mutton, s. mezamAMsaM, avimAMsaM.
MUTTON: (1) mezamAMsam;(2) mezAmizam, Bha.; and sim. comp.s.
MUTTON , s. OraBraM, OraBramAMsaM, mezamAMsaM, uraBramAMsaM, avimAMsaM.
MUTTON-CHOP , s. OraBramAMsaKaRqaH, mezamAMsaKaRqaH -RqaM.

Mutual, a. paraspara, anyonya, miTaH, itaretara, in comp.; ‘m(utual) help’ anyonyasAhAyyaM; oft. by prati pr.; ‘m(utual) obligation’ pratyupakAraH; pratiGAtaH, pratyaBiyogaH, &c. [Mutual]ity, s. parasparayogAH-BAvaH-saMbaMDaH, vyatikaraH, anyonyASrayaH, vyatihAraH. [Mutual]ly, adv. parasparaM, anyonyaM, miTaH, itaretaraM, (a.) in comp.
MUTUAL: (1) paraspara- in comp. or gen. (= one another: q. v.), m. love: parasparasya prItiH, Raj.;(2) sADAraRa (f. RI) (= common), m. good: sADAraRaM SreyaH, Mah.

MUTUAL , a. parasparaH -rA -raM, anyonyaH -nyA -nyaM, itaretaraH -rA -raM, vyatikaraH -rA -raM, miTaH in comp.; ‘mutual quarrel,’ anyonyakalahaH; ‘assistance,’ parasparopakAraH; ‘assent,’ parasparAnumatiH f.; ‘con- nexion,’ anyonyasambanDaH, miTaHsambanDaH, vyatizaNgaH; ‘aversion,’ anyonyaBedaH; ‘dependence,’ anyonyASrayaH; ‘enjoyment,’ vyati- karasuKaM; ‘attraction,’ anyonyAkarzakatvaM. The idea of ‘mutual’ is often expressed by some of the prepositions vi, A, ava, ati, prati, pra in combination, or by an adverbial compound formed by doubling a word; as, ‘mutual reproach or abuse,’ vyavakroSaH, vyAvakroSI, vyAvaBAzI; ‘laughter,’ vyavahAsaH, vyAvahAsI; ‘striking,’ daRqAdaRqi, pratiGAtaH, pratihananaM, vyatihAraH; ‘injury,’ vipratikAraH, viprakAraH, pratikAraH, viprakftiH f., pratyapakAraH; ‘assistance,’ pratyupakAraH; ‘connexion,’ vipratipattiH f.; ‘salutation,’ pratipUjanaM, pratyaBivAdaH; ‘accusation,’ pratyaBiyogaH; ‘recognition,’ pratyaBijYAnaM.

MUTUALITY , s. parasparayogaH, anyonyayogaH, itaretarayogaH, parasparatA, anyo- nyatvaM, parasparaBAvaH, anyonyaBAvaH, vyatikaraH, vyatihAraH, vyatIhAraH, anyonyasambanDaH, anyonyASrayaH, vyatizaNgaH.
MUTUALLY: (1) parasparam;(2) anyonyam;(3) miTaH, m. contending: miToviroDin (f. nI), Ki.

MUTUALLY , adv. parasparaM -rAM, anyonyaM, itaretaraM, miTas, anyonyasya, paraspara &c. in comp., uBaya in comp., ‘mutually assisting,’ parasparopakArI &c.; ‘mutually agreed,’ parasparAnumataH -tA -taM, uBayAnumataH &c.; ‘connected,’ miTaHsambadDaH -dDA -dDaM, vyatizaktaH -ktA -ktaM, vyatizaNgavAn -vatI &c.; ‘taken,’ anyonyApahftaH -tA -taM.
Muzzle, s. GoRA. 2 muKaM, praveSaH; Cidra, dvAra. 3 muKabaMDanI-roDanI. v. t. muKaM baMD 9 P or ruD 7 U.
MUZZLE (subs.): I Mouth: q. v.: muKam.II A fastening for the m.: muKabanDanam, -nI.
MUZZLE (v.): muKaM baDnAti (banD, c. 9.): v. To bind, prevent.
MUZZLE , s. (Mouth, entrance) muKaM, CidraM, praveSaH, praveSadvAraM, niHsaraRaM. — (Fastening for the mouth) muKabanDanaM -nI, muKaroDanI.
To MUZZLE , v. a. muKaMbanD (c. 9. baDnAti, bandDuM) or ruD (c. 7. ruRadDi, rodDuM).
MUZZLED , p. p. badDamuKaH -KA -KaM, rudDamuKaH -KA -KaM, nirudDamuKaH &c.

MY (1) mama or me (never at the beginning of a sentence) or mat in comp., I for my part think so: mama tAvanmatamidam, Si.; you are my second heart: tvamasi me hfdayaM dvitIyam, U. ; my wife: madgehinI, Me.;(2) madIyaH (yA, yaM), my milk: madIyaM payaH, R. ; like my mother: madIyA jananIva, R. ; (3) often not expr. when the meaning is clear, today is the tenth month from the demise of my father: adya daSamo mAsastAtasyoparatasya, Mu.; even my parents: pitarAvapi, D. ;(4) mAmakInaH (nA, naM) (rare).

MY , pron. a. mama gen. c. (asmat), madrIyaH -yA -yaM, mAmakInaH -nA -naM, asmadIyaH -yA -yaM, mat or asmat in comp.; ‘my master,’ mama praBuH or matpraBuH or asmatpraBuH; ‘my daughter,’ mama sutA or matsutA.
Myography, s. snAyuvarRanaM.
MYOGRAPHY , MYOLOGY, s. snAyuvarRanA, snAyuvivaraRaM, peSIvarRanaM.
Myope, s. alpadfS m., adIrGadfzwiH.
MYOPE , s. gajadfzwiH m. f., gajanetraH -trA, alpadfk m. f., adIrGadfzwiH.
MYOPY , s. gajadfzwitvaM, adIrGadfzwitvaM, adUradarSitvaM.
Myriad, s. ayutaM, daSasahasraM.
MYRIAD: ayutam; daSasahasram; M.s. of: sahasraSaH.
MYRIAD , s. daSasahasraM, ayutaM; ‘by myriads,’ daSasahasraSas.
Myrmidon, s. paricaraH, krUraparicaraH.
MYRMIDON: krUraparicaraH.
MYRMIDON , s. paricaraH, pariDisTaH, BartsanakArI sEnikaH or anucaraH.

Myrobalan, s. AmalakaH-kI-kaM, tizyaPalA, amftA, vayasTA; (‘beleric m(yrobalan)’) viBItakaH-kI-kaM, akzaH, tuzaH, karzaPalaH, BUtAvAsaH, kalidrumaH; ‘yellow m(yrobalan)’ avyaTA, aBayA, paTyA, kAyasTA, pUtanA, amftA, harItakI, hEmavatI, cetakI, SreyasI, SivA.
MYROBALAN: Amalakam, -kI.

MYROBALAN , s. (Emblic myrobalan, plant or fruit) AmalakaH -kI -kaM, tipyaPalA, amftA, vayasTA, vayaHsTA, kAyasTA. — (Beleric) viBItakaH -kI -kaM, akzaH -kzakaH, tuzaH, tusaH, karzaPalaH, BUtavAsaH, kalidrumaH. — (Yellow) aBayA, vyaTA, paTyA, vayasTA, vayaHsTA, kAyasTA, pUtanA, amftA, harItakI, hEmavatI, cetakI, SreyasI, SivA. — (The three myrobalans) triPalA.
Myrrh, s. bolaH, gaMDarasaH, rasagaMDaH, prARaH, piMqaH, goparasaH, gopaH, rasaH, gosaH.
MYRRH: (1) ganDarasaH;(2) rasaganDaH;(3) bolaH.
MYRRH , s. ganDarasaH, rasaganDaH, surasaM, mahAganDaM, jAtIrasaM, gAnDAraM, volaH, prARaH, piRqaH, gopaH -pakaH, gosaH, piRqagosaH, goparasaH, golaH -lakaH, rasaH, SaSaH, gosaSaSaH.
MYRTLE: latAviSezaH; *mUrtA.
MYSELF: I In person: svayam, I m.: svaya- mevAham, K.II. = me.: AtmAnam, I will show m.: AtmAnaM darSayizyAmi, K.
MYSELF , pron. so'ham, Atma n. (n); ‘I will kill myself,’ AtmAnaM hanippAmi.
MYSTERIOUS: (1) gahanaH (nA, naM) (= impene- -trable);(2) nigUQaH (QA, QaM) (= secret, obs- -cure);(3) durjYeyaH and sim. comp.s. (= un- -intelligible);(4) tAmasaH (sI, saM) etc. (= dark).

MYSTERIOUS , a. gUQaH -QA -QaM, atigUQaH &c., nigUQaH &c., gUQArTaH -rTA -rTaM, nigUQArTaH &c., guptaH -ptA -ptaM, atiguptaH &c., guptArTaH &c., gahanaH -nA -naM, sugahanaH -nA -naM, guhyaH -hyA -hyaM, gopyaH -pyA -pyaM, gopanIyaH -yA -yaM, rahasyaH -syA -syaM, surahasyaH &c., durjYeyaH -yA -yaM, durboDaH -DA -DaM, boDAgamyaH -myA -myaM, avyaktaH -ktA -ktaM, aspazwaH -zwA -zwaM; ‘pro- foundly mysterious,’ paramagahanaH -nA -naM; ‘mysterious in his ways,’ avyaktavartmA -rtmA -rtma (n).
MYSTERIOUSLY: (1) expr. with adj.;(2) gUQam, ni- (= secretly).
MYSTERIOUSLY , adv. gUQa, atigUQaM, paramagahanaM, avyaktaM, surahasyaM.
MYSTERIOUSNESS , s. gUQatA, atigUQatA, nigUQatA, gUQArTatA, nigUQArTatA, guhyatA, gopyatA, durjYeyatA, rahasyatA, avyaktatA.

Mystery, s. rahasyaM, ni-, gUQaM, guhyaM, gUQArTaH, gUQatattvaM, gahanavastu-vizayaH. [Myster]ious, a. niH-, gUQa, gahana, rahasya, guhya, gupta, gUQArTa, guptArTa, durjYeya, durboDa, avyakta, aspazwa, ‘m(ysterious) are the ways of Fate’ karmaRo gahanA gatiH; ‘a m(ysterious) person’ avyaktakarmA puruzaH, gUQacaritro naraH. [Myster]iously, adv. gahanaM, gUQaM. [Myster]iousness, s. gUQatA, gahanatA, durboDatA.
MYSTERY: nigUQatattvam, Ki. and sim. expr. s, m.ies of London: *laRqanarahasyAni (n.): v. Mysteri- -ous.
MYSTERY , s. gUQaM, nigUQaM, rahasyaM, guhyaM, gUQatattvaM, nigUQatattvaM, gUQArTaH, nigUQArTaH, gahanavastu n., marmma n. (n), gopyaM, gopanIyaM, nigUQavizayaH.
Mystic, [Mystic]al, a. gUQa, gupta, gahana; See Mysterious. [Mystic]ally, adv. gUQaM, gahanaM. [Mystic]ism, [Mystic]ness, s. gUQatA, gahanatA. Mystify, v. t. gahanIkf 8 U, gUQIkf.
MYSTIC, -AL: I Mysterious: q. v.: durjYeyaH (yA, yaM).II Belonging to mystics: expr. by comp.s.
MYSTIC (subs.): (1) paramahaMsaH (?), Pa.;(2) brahmaBikzuH (?), Pa.

MYSTIC , MYSTICAL, a. gUQArTaH -rTA -rTaM, guptArTaH &c., guhyaH -hyA -hyaM. See MYSTERIOUSNESS. (Involving some secret meaning). gUQArTagarBaH -rBA -rBaM, gUQABiprAyaH -yA -yaM, saNketagarBaH &c., lAkzaRikaH -kI -kaM; ‘mystic verse,’ mantraH; ‘mystic letter,’ vIjAkzaraM.
MYSTICALLY , adv. gUQArTatas, nigUQArTatas, sagUQArTaM, guptArTatas.
MYSTICALNESS , MYSTICISM, s. gUQatA, gUQArTatA, guptArTatvaM, gahanatvaM, rahasyatA.
MYSTICISM: I Obscurity: nigUQatA.II Doc- -trine of mystic: yogaDarmaH (?).
MYSTIFIED , p. p. mohitaH -tA -taM, vimohitaH -tA -taM, sagUQArTaH -rTA -rTaM.
MYSTIFY: (1) gahanIkarIti (?);(2) nigUQIkaroti (?).
To MYSTIFY , v. a. gUQIkf, gahanIkf, sagUQArTaM -rTAM kf, gUQatattvAni kaTayitvA parabudDiM muh (c. 10. mohayati -yituM) or vimuh.

Myth, Mythe, s. purARaM, purAvfttaM, purARa-purA-vftta-kaTA, purAvfttAKyAnaM, pOrARikI kaTA. 2 kalpitakaTA, kUwArTakaTA. [Myth]ic, [Myth]ical, a. pOrARika (kI f.), purARakaTita-ukta. 2 kAlpanika (kI f.), kUwArTa. Mythology, s. purARaM, itihAsaH, purARaSAstraM, devatAKyAnaM. [Mytholog]ical, s. pOrARika-EtihAsika- (kI f.); See above. [Mytholog]ist, s. purAvid m., purARa-vid, itihAsajYaH.
MYTH, -E: (?) itihAsaH purAtanaH, Mah.; pOrARikI kaTA.
MYTH , s. purAvfttakaTA, purAvfttopAKyAnaM, purARakaTA, purARoktopAKyAnaM, purARoktetihAsaH, purAvfttAKyAnaM, prAcInakaTA, purAvfttaM, purARaM, kUwArTakaTA.
MYTHIC , MYTHICAL, a. purAvfttakaTAsambanDI -nDinI &c., pOrARikaH -kI -kaM, purARakaTitaH -tA -taM, purARoktaH -ktA -ktaM, purAkalpitaH -tA -taM, kUwArTaH -rTA -rTaM.
MYTHICAL: I Lit.: pOrARikaH (kI, kaM).II Imaginary, fanciful: kAlpanikaH (kI, kaM).
MYTHOLOGICAL , a. purARakaTAsambanDI &c., purAvfttasambanDI &c., devatA- dikaTAvizayaH -yA -yaM, EtihAsikaH -kI -kaM, devatopAKyAnavizayaH &c. See MYTHIC.
MYTHOLOGIST: purARajYaH, Mah.; purARavid (m.); and sim. comp.s.
MYTHOLOGIST , s. purAvfttakaTakaH, purARavid m., devatopAKyAnaracakaH.
MYTHOLOGY: purARam (specially of the 18 Purāṇas of Hindus).
MYTHOLOGY , s. purAvfttaSAstraM, purARaSAstraM, purARetihAsaH, itihAsaH, purARakaTAvidyA, devatAdikaTAvizayA vidyA, devatopAKyAnavizayA vidyA, devatAKyAnaM.
